reviews.comment: It's clear the professor is interested in the topic. The topics discussed in this semester were relevant to modern life, followed well from each other, and very intuitively built up a basis for understanding common political behaviours. The testing followed very directly from the lectures. However, those lectures are near-impossible to watch.

Grade consists only of 3 exams & 5 quizzes (all open note). Pay attention to lecture and take good notes. Some of the criticism is just people complaining they actually had to put in any effort.

reviews.comment: This is a very easy class. Just watch the lectures and take good notes. The exams and quizzes are straightforward. Their all multiple choice, online, and open note. Honestly one of the easiest A's I've gotten at UT.

reviews.comment: Easy class where all quizzes and tests are over materiel covered by lectures and readings.

reviews.comment: You get what you sign up for. Don't listen to everyone rating this guy as terrible. He changed so much for the course because they complained so much. reviews.comment: This class was interesting but laborious. It is asynchronous, so you have to make sure not to fall behind watching lectures. These lectures are really boring and monotone, so its difficult to sit through at times. However, assesments are super easy. The tests and quizzes ask very simple and factual questions, so definetly doable, just painful.

Don't listen to everyone saying this is a hard class. I never watched a single lecture, did a single reading, and I got an A in the class. Share a group notes doc or use google and it's a free 3 hours that I honestly forgot was part of my schedule sometimes. He isn't very engaging by the sound of it but who cares, you'll never watch lectures anyway

reviews.comment: Keep in mind this is an asynchronous course so don't take it if you can't be self-motivated to do the lecture modules. Many people did not keep up and did poorly as a result. Exams are open-note and pretty straightforward. All in all a pretty boring class but if you need an easy gov credit and have limited room in your schedule take it.

He was horrible at teaching. All lectures were asynchronous and he spoke very slowly and used vocabulary that was difficult on top of difficult subject matter. I would not recommend him whatsoever. If you are able to, I would suggest taking this course through a community college.

don't listen to everyone. You are good as long as you watch the lectures and take good notes. Tests are open notes and the professor listened to feedback on things students didn't like/struggled with. He made changes for the benefit of the students. He is a really good professor.

I do not recommend taking this class if you're looking for an easy gov credit. Its very difficult to balance the coursework and lectures on top of other classes. The tests and the quizzes are hard and are filled with very specific questions from the lectures. He is also very monotone and its hard to stay engaged with the material.

Brownlees lectures are lengthy and sooooo boring. He reads from a script and is incredibly monotoned so he doesn't emphasize anything which makes it hard to tell what is important. Assessments are very difficult and unless you listened to each lecture and took detailed notes (which is nearly impossible without falling asleep) you will do terrible.

This class was not difficult in the slightest. The lectures are incredibly interesting and relevant. It was asynchronous so I didn't have any direct interaction with Brownlee, but from the lectures he seemed like a pretty good guy. I didn't bother doing the readings because he posted the answers to the reading questions. Decent amount of work.

Videos are way too long and garrulous. Brownlee struggles with his own script, and once you get to the quizzes, the 4+ lecture hours seem all for naught. I thought I learned a lot, but when test-time arrived, I knew hardly anything without the help of outside sources for specific and often trivial details... Major events < random, minute factors..?

I would not recommend taking this course asynchronously. Your entire grade is compromised of convoluted, lengthy multiple-choice questions spread out through quizzes and tests. He was not approachable over the semester and often cowered behind TAs for student communication.

reviews.comment: I think that he was a very interesting professor but I know a lot of his other students did not like his style. Overall, I enjoyed the class but format was rough

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE. I have never used rate my professor before, but I have to warn you. The professor reads off a paper when he lectures, one that is not available to students. Thought I would be bored, but I value what I have learned. Kind professor, Just watch lectures on 2x speed, no essays, multiple-choice & open-book exams. Defo take him (great online prof)

I feel like I have a truthful understanding on US stance in foreign relations with the Middle East; unweighted by patriotism or propaganda.

There are a lot of readings and lectures every week, which is expected for an online course. However, if you at least put in some effort, you will do well in the class. If you communicate with Brownlee and the TA's they will be very understanding. There were many test and quiz adjustments throughout the semester that helped make the class easier.

Absolute gem! I took this course Asynchronous and while there were a few hiccups, overall a very engaging class taught by a professor who seemed genuinely passionate. The open notes policy for tests is extremely generous and if you're stuck go to his office during hours he is very attentive to your questions. Just take good notes and you're golden!

Signed up for his class last minute. Spent a whole weekend catching up on 3 weeks of material, only for him to drop me & a bunch of other students last minute. He didn't even take the time to inform us. Very Stressful! I believe this professor is desensitized from his students and the class is too large for him to give quality education. Dont take!

reviews.comment: It's very hard to get an A in this class. The lectures are extremely convoluted and the power points do not help at all. There are no study guides, no online reviews, and no extra credit opportunities. Do not take this class.

reviews.comment: Professor Brownlee prerecorded the lectures and it looked like he didn't even know what he was talking about. The lectures were hard to follow and he took awkward gaps with a very monotone voice. There was barely any time  to finish the tests and quizzes, and those were the only grades for the class. I would not recomend taking this course!

I never RMP, but this was the first professor I needed to let yall know about. There is so much reading and very long lectures. Would not recommend it.

reviews.comment: Follow up from the 3.0 rating I made earlier. I was just really sleepy and irritated when I wrote it. He has changed my perspective significantly.

Have to watch 6 lectures a week that are each 30 minutes long. His sentences are convoluted, and I frequently have to rewind. Just the reading can take upwards of 4 hours. The grade is based only on tests (25% each) and quizzes (5% each). Be prepared to put in like 8 hours of work per week. He's knowledgable but this is so unnecessarily hard!!!

reviews.comment: The lectures are so extremely boring. Having to watch 6, 30 minute videos and read 30-50 pages a week is so draining. The class isn't even hard just tedious and hard to listen to. The online class at least is not engaging at all and puts you to sleep.

Professor Brownlee's lecture were very engaging. We had two readings per week (about 20 pages each) and only 3 tests/ 2 papers. He was clear about what he wanted to see and if you watched the lectures and did all of the readings, you'd certainly pass. I spent about 5 hours a week on this class, including lectures. Easy/fun class, highly recommend!

reviews.comment: If you need a gov credit, take him. You'll get a great grade if you do what little things he asks and his lectures aren't mandatory, but they will definitely benefit you if you go. Also, here are no exams, he is very approachable, and his lectures are a lot more interesting that i anticipated. I highly recommend! Take him and get a good grade.
Brownlee is super passionate and knowledgeable. He is really clear about grading and its super easy to do well. Grading is super lenient. He is super super.

Good professor who is very knowledgable about Middle East/US foreign policy. The class is two papers and three exams, all of which are take home and directly connected to the class material. Definitely would recommend taking him for a GOV312L credit, some of the other gov professors are significantly harder.

Good class to take for gov credit. Three papers and three tests make up a very large percent of your grade. LOTS of reading, do not fall behind or else you'll be cramming it all the night before the test. Lecture is required, most of the test material comes from it. Lectures are interesting if not a bit slow. Study guides are provided before tests.

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable guy, passionate about his subject and really cares about his students. His readings are heavy, and you'll be quizzed every week. Definitely recommend!

reviews.comment: I would take this class. It's completely changed my political beliefs. I'm not sure if it was the reading material or Professor Brownlee's lectures, but I walked in a moderate liberal and came out a leftist.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this class because it was required but I ended up having the BEST TIME. My friend and I are in this class together and now we're obsessed with foreign policy. Brownlee is super knowledgable and his exams are very fair. 11/10 recommend

One missed class will bring you down basically a letter grade. Lectures are circular, slow, and if they do end up coming to a point the point is generally something that any breathing human could have gotten to on their own at age 15. There's no final but there's a funky amount of busywork. Daily discussions are torturous. A very timid teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Brownlee really cares about his students. He was always very accommodating and willing to help. He was extremely knowledgable in his field, and exposed us to wide variety of sources. I feel like I am coming away knowing a lot more than I did when I entered his class. His tests are written, but he is very helpful in guiding you.

Definitely not worth the hype. The professor was hella dry and I did not find this class interesting at all. His lectures and extremely boring. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: 6 reflection papers (1 dropped), 2 in-class essay exams, and 1 research paper. An A is pretty difficult to achieve since the class is graded by such few things and Jason doesn't curve, but it's possible. Lots of reading, more than most classes, but manageable. TAs are helpful and participation matters in discussion sections. Class taught me a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This is a very interesting and easy UGS. There are many grades that are gimme 100s. You must show up to weekly discussion sessions but they're easy and enjoyable. Lectures are optional. He is invested in his students, really cares about their questions, and wants to give you the tools to make your own decisions. Very fair and well taught course

Best Class at UT- Brownlee is an amazing professor, attendance is not mandatory, material is actually interesting. Would take another class of his again. If you memorize the class made study guide, you will get an A. 3% extra credit. Highly recommend.

Professor Brownlee is a nice guy, but I regretted taking his government class in a way. The topic was very interesting and I enjoyed the lectures. However, it's hard to get an A in the class due to there being only 3 exams (30 pts) and 10 points for showing up on exam days. A difference of 3 points or a bad exam can ruin your grade. Lots to read!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: It was the easiest UGS ever. There were a lot of essays, but you have the chance to rewrite after you receive feedback. I never attended lectures and I still got a A, so I would 10/10 recommend

Brownlee is one of my favorite professors. I will definitely take another class of his. He puts his lecture slides online, so don't worry if you miss a class. Discussion classes are necessary because there are weekly 2 question quizzes. The UGS class is not that hard as long as you read and do the assignments. He doesn't grade too  hard.

I took Prof. Brownlee's Middle East Today course & loved it. He is very knowledgeable, & I learned a ton in the course. There are no tests, only essays. His lectures are interesting and easy to follow. I would definitely recommend this class if you have any interest in the Middle East, or his other classes, because he's awesome.

This course was very well organized and Dr. Bradbury is clearly interested in the work which makes participation easier and the curriculum more digestible. Expectations and grading strategy were clear and simple. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bradbury is super knowledgeable about all things Psych, and finds ways to make her lectures interesting. You can watch them at any time, and they aren't super long. Extremely easy class and useful for psych majors.

This class was a much needed easy a in my schedule. The lectures and supplemental material are interesting but easy to comprehend. There are no late grades until the end of the semester, so there's really no excuse for failing.

This class is one of the easiest but most enjoyable courses I've taken this year. You have to genuinely try not to get an A, because the entire course is online and open-note. Dr. Bradbury is really funny, and her lectures can be super interesting. I recommend taking this class if you need something easy and fun to fill up your schedule.
Such an amazing and truly funny professor. Never hesitate to take her course!
Super easy class, and super fun professor. Recommend this class if needing a PSY lower division!

I love Dr. Bradbury! Her lecture were so informative of the material covered and she also offered so much advice in life, like how to stay positive and optimistic. Class was graded on 1 quiz per week on the lecture material and there were 2 video projects.

Not a psych major, took this class cause online/async/easy and it was. But writing this RMP because Dr. B is genuinely such a kind soul, sometimes her positivity helped me during the semester for other things. I wish I had her optimism and positivity...
Genuinely the most interesting and easiest class I have taken

EASY A. Take this class if you need a UGS class! Amazing professor who is super understanding and laid back. Very few not hard assignment. Laid back about due dates and can miss about 10 classes without it effecting your grade. Genuinely a good person to talk to and have as a recommendation.
Good lectures and a good class.

Clinical psych with Bradbury is one of the best classes in the psych major. TAKE IT. Her lectures are super interesting and easy to understand and readings aren't too heavy. Quizzes could sometimes be hyper-specific but as an online asynch course I get that. She was very nice and helpful over email too!
One of the best and most inspirational teachers I've had.
Love love love love LOVE her. Taken her FOR ANY COURSE if you can

Professor Bradbury is the whimsical, interesting professor you're expecting when you pick psychology as a major. She is someone who enjoys the topics she teaches and provides several connections to help you understand!

I really hated how this class was formatted. We had quizzes almost every other day, and the material itself wasn't hard but rather the amount of readings and lectures she provided was too much to do in a short amount of time. Each quiz was spaced out 2-3 days. Dr. Bradbury herself is fine, lectures tend to be repetitive and unnecessarily long.

I've taken Dr. Bradbury twice now, and both times she has easily remained my favorite professor of the semester. She is so kind and understanding, which is reflected in her recorded lectures and assignment leniency. The class itself is asynchronous and incredibly easy to do well in. I'd recommend her to anyone who needs a nice course to fill hours.

Weekly lectures & quiz. 2 video assignments, & weekly journaling. Bradbury made watching online lectures super engaging and great. Easy class & quizzes are in-line with lecture & attached sources. She is such a kind, caring prof. Big emphasis on well-being/positivity. Very clear and understandable lecture style. AMAZING PROF, can't recommend more!

Dr. Bradbury cares about her students and lets her students work at their own pace for the asynch class. She's positive, even through the videos without direct contact. Quizzes every week (all various types of questions), two video assignments, and self-graded journaling. Easy class. She also provides post-grad resources, so you know she cares
Kindest professor and interesting content

I love Dr. Bradbury's lectures! She made personality such a fun topic to learn about and broke down each personality theory in such an easy way. There was one 10 question quiz each week about the lecture. 2 video assignments also make up the grade, which were a fun way to showcase what we think of in terms of personality.

Everything is done on your own time/pacing except for two video assignments. Class content is so easy you hardly have to pay attention to the material, but it is all very interesting so you might want to, anyway! Dr. Bradbury is a great professor and easy grader who clearly wants students to succeed.
AMAZING LOVE HER TAKE HER! quizzes are so doable and so are the video assignments. completely async & i have nothing else to say other than she's wonderful!
this class is very easy and is completley asynchronous
Bradbury was super nice. This was an easy PSY course that I would def rec and take again. Simple asynch assignments are majority of the grade.

Really enjoy this prof. This is my second class with her and I definitely recommend her. She cares and knows a lot about what she teaches. Modules with lecture videos, some readings, and a quiz. 2 1-minute video assignments that are easy with clear grading. Open lectures and open notes for quizzes. Lectures and readings are actually interesting.

Easy A class with engaging content. Professor Bradbury is super helpful and understanding. Quizzes are straightforward, and deadlines are flexible. unstuck ai was a great study tool alongside the video assignments.
Dr. Bradbury is the best! Manageable class and reasonable assignments. Quizzes can sometimes have trick questions but, overall, great class.

Took the 5 week summer course. Super easy class, multiple quizzes that are not difficult, and a couple of assignments here and there. The professor herself was not easy to get in touch with despite sending multiple emails, for the most part the TA handled all the work and was wonderful.
Dr. Bradbury is always a joy to have as a professor, and there are really useful basic skills to be learned from her intro to clinical course.

mega easy class. 14 modules- vids, quiz (2 dropped) + ethics journaling assignment (self-graded) each week,  due at the end of the semester, and 2 short video assignments (the only hard deadlines). they're pretty accommodating w those too lowkey. dr.b's lectures are super positive n peppy n i appreciated that. def a really easy A and a fun course.

What an easy A. On the level of Jazz Appreciation. Weekly quizzes and optional journaling assignments (lol) that are supposed to be done week by week, but are technically due at the end of the semester. So you can def speedrun this class in the last week. Except for 2 video assignments, which are the only hard deadlines in this class.

One of the easiest and most interesting classes I've ever taken. Dr. Bradbury is truly so interesting to learn from. This class is very forgiving and is self-paced. Quizzes were open-note and were based on the lectures and readings. There were 2 easy video projects and self-graded journaling assignments. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!

This is the easiest class I've ever taken and its also fun and interesting! There's no enforced due dates so you can take the class at your own pace, but it's very easy to allow things to pile up. She's so sweet and her lectures are fun, highly recommend her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradbury genuinely cares about each student succeeding. Class is divided into modules all due at the last class day. Quizzes are straightforward and untimed. Overall a really enjoyable class that is probably the most stress-free it can get
Super caring and wants you to succeed! Watch online lectues, complete (untimed, online) quizzes, and do few easy projects and you will be good. Super easy yet interesting course!

Prof. Bradbury is the epitome of an amazing professor. She genuinely cares about her students, not only their grades but their mental health too. There are modules broken down for every week with clear instructions and a simple quiz with every module that covers the material. Highly recommend.

Bradbury is knowledgeable and passionate. She has good advice for after college. The class is a bit boring but easy. It's fully online so make a designated time each week to complete the weeks work. There are a couple lectures, a quiz, and a journaling assignment each week, no exams. There are 2 video assignments that are fairly easy and short.

There are no hard deadlines so it is easy to get behind, but also easy to get ahead! This is the kind of class you can finish 2 weeks before finals and spend your time on other classes. This class had interesting content, however, so it is not like you'll be glad to be done because it is not hard!

so easy- weekly quiz for each module and two video assignments as well as journaling. journaling isn't checked and is self-graded. quizzes are easy if you do what's in the module and take good notes. all quizzes were due last class day, so there's no real "deadlines" but it's easy to fall behind because of that. highly recommend !

I took her into to clinical psych course for my degree, but found it really helpful Tbh. it was all lecture based with some small journaling assignments, but overall was a really good (and doable) class when compared to my other content heavy classes.
So sweet. Lectures are interesting and quizzes follow them, no surprises. Video assignments are fun, great class.

The class is pretty easy, but it's laughable how little the professor or lead TA care. The TA just straight up told me the professor has NO involvement in the course, and it's all run by her lead TA. It is literally impossible to get a hold of the professor whose name is on the course. And the lead TA (Cherry) is rude and condescending to students.

Although the class was asynchronous, Dr. Bradbury's kindness and genuine care for her students is incredibly evident! Feels a bit lecture-heavy sometimes but it is all very tolerable. I highly recommend this course.

I absolutely enjoyed this class. Dr. Bradbury seems like a very understanding and caring professor. I personally seeked a lot of help from her TAs and shout out to them because they are absolutely amazing. They are so understanding and friendly and I couldn't thank them enough. There's a clear grading criteria and it's very easy to get an A! :)

Also took for PSY 364. These online classes with Dr. Bradbury were amazing! The self paced classes were great for getting the work done and Dr. Bradbury is extremely flexible. Two short video assignments and weekly quizzes were the major assignments.

Easy Online Class. Grade is determined by 15 quizzes (one on each topic), 2 video assignments, and private topic related journaling for every chapter (not required to turn in). Lectures are fun to listen to and quizzes are 10 mc questions based on lecture + reading material given for the week. Well organized. TA's are responsive and work with you.

Enjoyable class as always! Bradbury has a good structure to her classes and is a great lecturer. Only thing is, make sure to stay on top of your work as this is an asynchronous class (wish it had more deadlines). The quizzes would sometimes also have content that felt like it wasn't in the lectures; don't take the quizzes entirely too lightly.

Was a very fun and educational class. HIGHLY recommend to psych major or anyone just curious to take it. Dr. Bradbury is very fun and clearly passionate about the topic, which makes it more engaging. Huge applauses to her and would love to take another class from her soon!
all asynchronous online, super easy quizzes, 2 video assignments easy to get full credit. take for an easy A and learn more about personality psychology

I'm in the minority on Dr. Bradbury but I really did not like her as a professor. I lost one point on an assignment and she refused to explain why. It felt very frustrating to not receive any feedback. She is well informed and passionate about the topic which is a plus! But, I wish she gave more feedback instead of making everything an easy 100%.

She such a good professor and one of the easiest classes i've taken while at the same time furthering my education of psych and personality. She has lectures that are actually engaging which helps you do better on quizzes. Also quizzes are open everything which helps you look for the answer on your own, which helps you understand it more. Very easy
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradbury is extremely caring and passionate about clinical psychology. The class is super easy and interesting.
Such a good prof! So caring about her students and wants you to succeed. lectures are interesting and content is easy to learn.

Dr. Bradbury is so nice and really cares about her students. I took this class online, but her and her TAs were always super understanding and lenient with students. Plus, the material was interesting. It is self-paced with no exams. I definitely recommend this class.

I loved taking Personality Psych with Dr. Bradbury! The class is all online, so you can complete the weekly quizzes on your own time or by the end of the semester. You have weekly quizzes based on her single lecture video and very small readings. I would recommend it if you are a BS in psychology and want a stress-free and interesting course.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Bradbury's Summer Course and despite the course having a lot of material to get through in only 5 weeks, I truly learned so much from this class. Bradbury is an amazing lecturer know material and provides incredible insight of a clinical setting. My only complaint is that I wish I took it during a full term to really let it all sink in.

very interesting class, but Dr. Bradbury was even better. She made the class what is was and was very easy to follow and made it clear what was expected. Very caring and understanding, easy class and wonderful content! Please take her!

Dr. Bradbury is incredibly knowledgable in her field and SO SO passionate about her work. She organizes the class in a way that is catered to students and with an understanding that we have lives outside of class. Lecture material is all super interesting - do the work and you are certain to end the class with a solid grade.

She is so energetic and radiates positive energy! Her lectures are very easy to understand, and they're entertaining. The class is structured with a quiz each week (open note and untimed), weekly journaling assignments, and two video assignments. I will say, you will have to really understand the content to do well on some of the quizzes!

She has a great personality, and her energy just brightens up the room! She's very passionate about what she teaches and is a great advocate for recognizing issues in practice and beyond the classroom.
literally my fav course i have taken at UT i love dr. bradbury and cannot recommend her enough
Take this class. Dr. Bradbury is one of the best professors at UT, she is very kind and understanding and her lectures are just phenomenal.
Have taken her twice, incredibly easy but also filled with great info, she definitely cares about her students, provides lots of great resources, encourages you to work with classmates, no tests

350 letters are not enough to talk about how much I love Professor Bradbury! Caring professor who wants the best for her students. Class is graded on open-note quizzes and two video assignments and she makes it really hard to not do well. Do not miss the chance to take her!!

She is so awesome, I loved having her an have taken several classes with her - I wish I could take every class with her. She's so accommodating and lenient and cares about her students more than anything else.
You can tell she knows so much about psychology and is extremely passionate! I recommend taking her personality psychology class as it is both interesting and an easy A if you attend lecture.

Dr. B is an amazing instructor! She combines her clinical experience really well with her pedagogic methods, which makes learning psychology pleasant and effective for students.
She goes above and beyond to accommodate students' needs. Definitely take any of her classes if you can!

Professor Bradbury is great, she's so nice and you can tell she really cares about her students. This was a very interesting class, not stressful or too time-consuming (she makes it clear that this is not a class you should worry about). The grade is only made up of quizzes, a journaling grade (self-graded), and 2 video assignments.

This class is so easy: you get to work with friends during quizzes and you can work ahead and be done with the class way before the semester ends. There are no late grades either besides two easy video projects! The only complaint is that Dr. Bradbury doesn't respond to Canvas emails, so you have to go through the TA for questions.

I honestly forgot I was taking this course throughout the semester how easy it was. You can work ahead and easily finish the coursework and be done with it. Though if you do want a consistent work schedule be wary because modules are posted at nondescript times.

Dr. Bradbury is a very engaging and intelligent lecturer. She is deeply fascinated by the field of psychology, and she really wants her students to not only learn but thrive! It is easy to fall behind in this class, so I would recommend working on it bit by bit rather than leaving it all to the end. The content is also very interesting. Take notes!
This class was so much fun! I had an incredible time taking this course and I would definitely recommend!
Dr. Bradbury clearly loves what she does. This is probably the best psychology course I have taken. 10/10 recommend.

A quiz per week on her lectures and two video assignments - straightforward and very easy to follow. Only spent two hours per week and quiz questions are directly from lectures and its open note. She doesn't have office hours and she doesn't reply to emails that fast so make sure to use TA's before you go to her. Anyone can get an A!

This class was great, as long as you read the supplied materials and looked at the lecture you were able to answer the 10-question quizzes every week. There were two video assignments that were one minute each which corresponded to a topic in class. If you need help with anything just reach out to her and the ta's, they really care.

This class was great, as long as you read the supplied materials and looked at the lecture you were able to answer the 10-question quizzes every week. There were video assignments that were one minute each which corresponded to a topic in class. If you need help with anything just reach out to her and the ta's, they really care.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Bradbury. She's so passionate about her work and extremely kind, she really wants everyone to succeed in her class! I loved this course, and I never found it a chore to watch her lectures or supplemental material. I would love to take more of her classes, she was a delight to learn from!

LOVED LOVED LOVED THIS CLASS!!! Took Intro to Clinical Psych. It's async so you can do everything on your own time. Really amazing and I loved it. You get what you put in and she really cares about the content of this class. TAKE HER!!!

Great professor! Took this class as a business major to fulfill an upper-division non-business course and got through it with ease! Dr. Bradbury cares about her students and makes sure to provide useful resources throughout the course. Take this class if you need the credit!

Literally the most forgiving and understanding professor I've ever had at UT. I've taken multiple classes with her and she's been constantly great. I always look forward to her classes at the beginning of each semester. Take her if you can!

Where do I begin with Dr. Bradbury?! She's an absolutely fabulous professor and makes all of her course material SO interesting! Her class is relatively easy, with modules that have lectures, readings, and other videos, then a quiz. None of the modules are due until the end of the semester, so there aren't hard deadlines.

Definitely take this professor!!!! Shes amazing! Her classes are interesting and she is one of the most caring and comprehensive professors i have taken! So far i have taken 3 courses with her and I definitely recommend!!!

Dr. Bradbury has to be one of the best professors in the psychology department or at UT in general. I love her energy and her quizzes as they really are not difficult to answer if you watch and can engage with her lectures. Which are great in my opinion. I did not struggle much in her course and would say it was my favorite course this semester.

she is an amazing and caring professor, psych personality is such an interesting class! just manage your time with the modules (since it's asynchronus) and you will be fine! there's 2 video projects and 12 quizzes, all open note.
TAKE THIS CLASS! Even if you're not a psych major, it's easily understandable, fun, and not very difficult. Professor Bradbury is an absolute gem!!!

Dr. Bradbury cares so much for her students which makes taking her class so nice. The class consists of 12 quizzes (if you watch and do all the required stuff you will do good) and 2 video assignments. You can take this class at your own pace which was great for me. I had so much fun in this class and I highly recommend taking a class with her!

I love Dr. Bradbury. I truly can't say enough positive things about her - her lectures are engaging, she gives you a sweet self-care tool kit, and she genuinely WANTS you to get an A in her class. She'll give an extension if you need one and is honestly one of the sweetest people ever. I've taken almost all of her classes.

I LOVE DR B!! Take her if you have the chance. Her lectures are such a treat! She's funny, relatable, and overall awesome! for each module you have a lecture/reading (but it's good!) and then a quiz (one try, not timed, VERY doable) and a journaling assignment. Couldn't recommend her enough, I just want to be her bestie. Also PSY 309 is so cool!!

She is an angel!! Class is engaging and challenging, but not extreme. Most assignments for her asynchronous class are due at the very end of the semester so you basically move at your own pace with the exception of a few assignments. Love her and she makes it so easy to learn!! She is also so knowledgable and helpful!

Please take her if you can. She is so nice and genuinely cares about everyone doing well. Her lectures are super fun and the quizzes are all open resource and easy. You won't have to worry about your grade at all she offers so much extra credit. Everything is due at the end of the semester and consists of mainly quizzes and fun video assignments.

Whatever class you're considering to take with Dr.B: JUST TAKE IT! She's an angel! Super caring and extremely knowledgeable--you can see she wants her students to succeed & she goes out of her way to help when needed. Class is structured in a very friendly-non-pressuring way that allows you to succeed at your own pace. One of my fave profs so far!

TAKE HER! She was super chill and makes the class so easy, yet so fun. Never had to worry about my grade. She is super caring and kind. She really wants everyone to succeed. If you have any problem getting work done just talk to her and she will happily help. Loved her so much I will be taking one of her other courses. No text all materials free.
I enjoyed watching Dr. B's recorded lectures. There are required readings and video projects, but they were not hard to follow and the quizzes were straightforward. She also offers extra credit!

Prof B is super sweet and her recorded lectures are very engaging. She wants to see her students succeed and she gives them plenty of room to do so. Although the course felt laid back, it was packed with meaningful material. I really enjoyed it!
Dr. B is a great professor, she is clear on her grading system. Lectures are enjoyable and so are the readings she assigns (most of them). She genuinely cares for her students' success.

Dr. Bradbury is very sympathetic, understanding and has the best lectures. The course format is all online and due dates are all set by you with recorded lectures and given material. There are only 12 quizzes, 2 video assignments and a self graded journal. I highly recommend this professor, she has been my favorite at UT so far!
SHE IS THE QUEEN OF PSYCHOLOGY. SO KNOWLEDGABLE, SWEET, AND CARING. NOT TO MENTION FANTASTIC LECTURES. TAKE HER!!!

This is my 2nd time taking a class with this professor and she is the BEST professor at Austin in my opinion. This class is graded on a few things: 12 quizzes (2 are extra credit/optional) and 3 video assignments that are EASY. Quizzes are super easy too if you pay attention to her online video lecture. No textbook used and class is asynchronous.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You HAVE to take this class. It's amazing and an easy way to get an A. The tests are not hard at all, if you pay attention in class you will get A's on them. The quizzes are super easy! The class is all online and no textbook is used. You watch her online lectures and take a small quiz after each module. The lowest 8 quizzes are dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bradbury is my favorite professor at UT. This is my third class with her and she is the best! All of her classes are super easy. Class only entailed self graded journals, 12 quizzes and 2 video assignments. I recommend her to everyone. She is super caring and respects her students

This is the second course I've taken from Dr. Bradbury. She can ramble a bit, but the lectures tend to be interesting and easy to digest. The course consists of Modules (asynchronous due dates) and two assessment projects that have harsh deadlines (these are very easy). Take this class and learn about child behavior problems!

Loved this class and her! You can tell she's passionate about the subject and does a great job explaining it in lectures. Also makes the assignments fun and interesting. I feel like I could have learned a lot more, but I still recommend taking her classes if you're a psych major! Also, she's very difficult to contact in email or office hours.

Dr. Bradbury was an amazing and very understanding professor with classes being online due to covid. The class material was very straightforward and easy to understand as well as interesting to learn about. Due to the workload and grading criteria, I did not need to worry about this class during all this uncertainty which was very helpful mentally.

one of THE best professors ever. if you have the chance to take professor bradbury, DO IT! her lectures are like watching TV!! extremely interesting, and what makes it better is that there is no textbook for the class! youll want to go to class if you take her:) she has a passion for psych, and cares so much about her students.

She's a real gem and so wholesome. Her class does have a bunch of quizzes but as long as you watch the lectures and study a bit you'll be fine. I will definitely try and have her again in the future for other psych classes. Her journal assignments are self-graded and the projects are really fun to do. Loved her class, and her lectures are awesome.

Dr. Bradbury is AMAZING. Her quizzes are straightforward, the lectures were interesting and she offers extra credit. You have 3 video assignments, 10 quizzes and a self-graded journaling. Its self paced and everything has to be in by a certain date, but if you do a quiz a week, you'll finish a week before the deadline. HIGHLY recommend.

Easiest class. just had to watch the required lecture material and take quizzes. no test, no finals. only quizzes, 2 video assignments, and self-graded journal activities. the kindest teacher ever, 100/10 would recommend, protect this woman at all costs. the lectures were super interesting and so easy to follow along.

She's my absolute favorite prof at UT. She gives information so clearly and concisely, and the way she explains it makes it super easy to understand and interesting. A year later, I still think about her classes. Pay attention to random hours for deadlines though - messing this up once brought me from an A- to a B+ for Clinical Psych.
Dr. B is a sweetheart. She really cares about what she's teaching and for her students. The TA's can be picky when it comes to assignments so be sure to follow all directions.

I took Abnormal and Clinical Psychology with Dr. Bradbury because she was just so wonderful. Even if you aren't interested in psych (I'm not a psych major) she is such a warm and incredible person who will teach you how to live a rich and happy life. She's also the only reason for my 98th percentile score on the psych section of the MCAT. Take her.

Dr. Bradbury is an amazing online professor! Her lectures were always so interesting and she made them a lot of fun. The tests aren't too difficult if you keep up with the material and do the study guide or rewatch lectures right before the test. If you can, I highly recommend to take a class with Dr. Bradbury!

Dr Bradbury is by far one of the best online professors. She makes material so easy to understand and takes the time to explain harder concepts. (There are not really any hard concepts in this class). Super easy online class allows you to take tests at home

I loved this class! Dr. Bradbury was very knowledgable and had lots of experience in many fields. All you really have to do is watch the lectures and take the 3 question quizzes before the due dates. The tests were based off of notes and the readings/videos for the lectures. There are two assignments outside of watching lectures. Take this class!!!

Dr. Bradbury's lectures were eye-opening and really inspired me to change my outlook on the world. I took it online so I could do it at my own pace. The quizzes were easy. The exams were more difficult, you have to remember detailed info and dx criteria. Take good notes and study well before exams because they are worth most of the grade.

This class is pretty easy. Pre-recorded lectures and modules to go with them. You get plenty of drops so there's room for error. The exams were easy as well but they compromise most of the grade so bombing one could hurt you. Her lectures were fun and interesting. She's very respected among her students and for a good reason!

The lectures are already pre-recorded, so attendance doesnt matter. Dr. Bradbury does a really good job at translating content straight from lecture to test. It was super easy. Theres a benchmark for every module and I could get 3/3 on almost all of them without trying. Best way to navigate the class is to take really good notes on the lectures.
10/10 recommend clinical psych online, easy, structured and Dr. B is the best. Absolute legend

Took Abnormal Psych online with her. Hands down the best class and the best professor I've had here at UT! Lectures are incredibly interesting and engaging, she presents material in an informative and entertaining matter. Required materials will help inform you further on the subject matter, and the optional material will do so further.
Amazing professor. She makes me love psychology and genuinely enjoy doing work for it. Her lectures are inspiring and interesting, I wish I could take her for every class
You could literally never watch any of lectures or read any of the material for this class and pass.

Took this as a web based class. As long as you read the slides, watch all of the lectures, and take notes, you will pass. Class consists of 5 short, 500-word writing assignments and 4 exams which were all pretty straightforward and from the lectures.

Don't be fooled by the word "abnormal", the class isn't nearly cryptic as it sounds. That doesn't mean the material isn't worth learning though. Lots of self-help material included. She's EXTREMELY knowledgeable, hard-working, and honestly over-qualified to be a professor. She does it because she loves teaching that much. Can't recommend enough.

Dr. Bradbury is hands down one of the best professors I've ever had! She's caring & her lectures will interest you. Only 4 exams, 4 writing assignments, and module quizzes, which are all very easy. Plus, Dr. Bradbury provides tips on how you can give a happier life! If you need a GPA booster, take this class! You'll learn a lot from Dr. Bradbury.

Dr. Bradbury is a wonderful, upbeat woman who actually cares about her students unlike most professors. Even if you're not going into the psychology field, this class is super interesting and helpful. Extremely easy A, definitely a GPA booster. Highly, highly recommend.

Best class and professor I have ever had at UT. She really cares not only about her students success, but their mental health. Easy benchmark Quizzes and writing assignments. Exams are pretty straightforward however there were some weird exam questions . Averages on exams have been 88, 89, 87, 90. Take HER!!!

Lovely person, lovely class! Take it if you have the opportunity - the workload is doable, and the information is really interesting. You can do the modules at your own pace, but the exams are on specific dates. Ill definitely take any class from her I can, she seems so sweet, patient, and knowledgeable.
Love, love, love her! I wish she was my professor for every class! She keeps things fun and interesting and I don't dread lectures.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Bradbury. I took her online abnormal psych class but it felt like I could still get to know her. Her office hours always have a wait because of how welcoming she is. She's a great person and professor alike.

Dr. Bradbury's online Abnormal Psych class was so much fun and very interesting. She clearly outlined her expectations in grading. Some of the quiz questions were a bit tricky, but there was a fair appeal process in place. Overall, her class was enlightening and I recommend her particular section of anything because of her bubbly personality.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love her so much she is so awesome and open minded! Just watch the lectures and do the readings and you will be fine, I feel like the purpose of the class is to learn instead of stressing out about tests and I can tell she understands that. Also on the side note she reminds me of Tina Fey lol

One of my favorite classes I've taken! Dr. Bradbury cares about her students and their well being. The material was very interesting and relevant. I have nothing bad to say!!! She's awesome, love her story.

I absolutely loved Bradbury's class because she was very relatable and funny during her lectures which gave me a mental break from my more difficult courses. When I joined the course, I thought it was going to take up a lot of time, but it took an hour to prepare for it. To ace the benchmarks, rewatch the lectures and take solid notes on them.

Dr. Bradbury is by far my favorite professor at UT. She is so caring and knowledgeable. I love her enthusiasm and genuine interest in her students and the material she's teaching. There are benchmarks (quizzes) everyday, so don't skip class. There are also assignments that are As as long as you do them. I enjoyed this class so much and learned tons
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't have a single bad thing to say about Dr. Bradbury. Abnormal psych was fun and interesting, which made it easy to study for and easy to get an A. Just take this class, you won't regret it.

Dr. Bradbury is so sweet. I took this online, so we had to watch the lectures and take a quiz on them after. I got to meet her in person and she's very knowledgable and very passionate about her work. As long as you watch the modules her tests are very straight forward. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Bradbury is amazing. I have taken 2 of her online classes and I have never had a professor teach so clearly and entertainingly. I don't know why anyone would say anything negative about her or the classes. There were some technical issues at times but the TA's and Dr. Bradbury were very understanding. I learned way more than regular lectures.

Maybe I'm just sad deep down, but I found her excessive happiness to be artificial and annoying. If you take this class online, it ISN'T live. It's a recording of a class from 2 years ago (imagine the problems this creates w/ dates). The class itself is a joke. Use Ctrl-F you can ace her daily quizzes (90% of you grade) without paying attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradbury changed the way I look at education, people, the world, and myself. She is one of the best, if not the absolute best, professors I've ever had. I'm not kidding when I say when her class ended I cried literal tears. Taking one of her classes changed my educational career, and I've considered transferring back to UT just for her. No joke

I took this class online and was kind of hard, 26 Benchmarks (1 x class) and 4 short essays (under 500 words). The benchmarks (quizzes) are a mess, we had "SEVERAL" of them graded incorrectly due to their wrong answers. You have to pay close attention to them to make sure they are graded right. *I had to email the TAs several times on such matter.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I didn't learn a whole lot taking online Abnormal Psych. The online format allowed you to easily blow off the class. Although it's an easy A, I wouldn't recommend if you actually want to learn this material. There are no tests-- only daily quizzes which you can use your notes for. So naturally, I didn't study because I didn't really need to.

Best professor I've ever had. Got to meet her in person and she is super cool and nice. Awesome voice and super smart. Very passionate about her field and about teaching. Likes to make jokes and is all around an amazing professor and person. Take her if you can!

I took online Abnormal Psych with Dr. Bradbury that had been recorded during a previous semester. The class was amazing, well-structured, and informative. Grades are based on 8 question open-note benchmarks at the beginning of each class plus a couple one page papers that are graded for completion. I learned so much from this class.

Dr. Bradbury is so sweet! I had her for abnormal psych. I don't really like the online broadcasting format, but the good news is there are no tests. Instead, at the beginning of class, you take an 8-question quiz. This does mean you can't get behind and you have to do the readings and take good notes, but she offers great destress & life advice <3

Dr. Bradbury is a wonderful professor who genuinely cares about her students. She's positive, inspirational, and always happy to meet students. 4 writing assignments (short, super easy), no exams but daily benchmark (8 questions about the previous lecture), and a one-question quiz at the end of each lecture. Not the easiest A, but definitely doable
Great professor and person, University needs more professors like her! you can tell she cares about her students. Very well spoken and smart professor. Highly recommend!

She really cares about her students and does a great job of explaining concepts. No tests no final just daily benchmarks worth 60% of your grade. Class topics were very interesting and engaging. Easy A and interesting class.
This class was very informative. The online setting was wonderful. It was obvious that she genuinely cared to get to know her students and cared for their well-being.
wonderful professor. Definitely recommend. Online abnormal psych was my favorite class this semester!

Dr. Bradbury is hands down the best professor I have had at UT. She is one of the smartest people I have ever met, while also being incredibly kind. Her lectures are so engaging, she knows her stuff, and she knows how to get students to really understand. I plan on taking every class that she teaches, because her intro psych class was so wonderful.

I can't even begin to describe how amazing Dr. Bradbury is. She genuinely cares about all her students. Office hours are amazing and engaging. I already had AP credit for psych and was skeptical about taking psych again with her, but it is so worth it. She is such an amazing human all around and so respected by all of her students. Take her class!

Dr. Bradbury is AMAZING! She makes her lectures extremely interesting and she is really funny. She loves talking to students and helping, so make sure to attend her office hours. There are only two exams and they are pretty difficult but the end-of-the-year project and the 2 writing assignments are very easy.
Dr. B is a great teacher and a great person to just go and talk to. Take the time to go to her office hours-very worth it

Dr. B is so great! I am so glad I got to have her my first semester. The big project at the end of the class is worth the bulk of your grade, and pretty much everyone makes an A. However, her class is AMAZING. You won't mind getting up in the morning. Her lectures are so entertaining, and she is so caring towards her students.

Love, love, love Dr. Bradbury! She gives out random extra credit, so go to class. She literally reviews the entire exam the class before the test. And she actually cares about her student. By far my favorite professor!

Dr. B is my favorite professor I've ever had! Her lectures are FASCINATING. I never want them to end. She's also very flexible and always there for you if you're having trouble with something. Just go to office hours. I wish she taught more classes so I could take them all.
Wonderful inspirational professor. She embodied what she taught and always seemed happy to teach. You won't regret taking this class.

Dr Bradbury was truly an inspirational and wonderful profesor. I had her for intro to Clinical Psych and she exemplified to me the ideal therapist while teaching it. The class went beyond psychology and into my daily life as well. Everything was easy gradewise as long as you paid moderate attention.
More than just an easy "A" class: you will leave every lecture in a better mood (: she is passionate, entertaining, and worth every minute of your time.
Easily one of the best psych lecturers at UT. Get to know her if you can. She's very personable, a great lecturer, informative and keeps class interesting.
Take this class! Dr. B is awesome, entertaining, and if you at all try you can make an A (she has the test in her hand the class before exam day, and tells you everything that you need to know...)

Dr. B is so awesome! She makes her class very interesting and fun to attend. She doesn't take roll, but I wouldn't recommend missing class because whatever the little anecdotes she mentions are always included on exams. I really loved her class am looking forward to having more classes with her!

Dr. Bradbury is a professor who truly loves what she does, and she's good at doing it. On top of being a mother, wife, and professor, she also has her own clinical practice. Yet she still puts 100 percent into teaching. She makes psychology come alive and relates everything she teaches to how it personally affects you. She's really one of a kind!
bradbury is the best professor i have had at UT! everyone needs to take her for PSY301 or any other class she teaches!
No Comments

As a CS major, this class made me want to change majors. The coding assignments were fun but the lectures and tests were NOT IT. Her tests are heavy on "can you do this? what will error out?" and her lectures just go on and on about syntax and stuff. She seems like a nice person and office hours helped a lot but I will try not to take her again.

The situation is that the professor is great but the class is extremely difficult, likely in an effort to prepare us for computer architecture. While her quick pace might be difficult for some, I personally had little issue following along. On top of that, Professor Kaur is literally reading books on kindness, like she clearly cares about students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Currently in her course. She is honestly a great professor, like she teaches awesome and I never seen a professor care for students more than her. But she talks incredibly fast just for us to somehow be way behind on material and work and then somehow her exams are unnecessarily harder compared to Mike Scotts, just some random harder applications.

Kaur is kind and engaging in her lectures, and she makes compsci accessible to those who have never encountered it before. The exams are very difficult but doable, and we were given cheat sheets for each one. It will take a lot of work, but a good grade is certainly accessible.

Very engaging, easy-to-understand lectures, but we are graded on 3 tests that basically make up 90% of our grade, which are pretty difficult. Programming assignments are hard to get full points on, but extra credit makes up for those. Amrita was a very helpful professor, and most of the TAs are very helpful as well.

Pretty good professor. Lectures and weekly assignments are engaging and interesting. Weekly assignments are graded harshly but there's a ton of extra credit so its not hard to offset the tough grading. If you do the practice tests she gives you its not hard to get 90+ on exams. If you did UIL CS this course will be extremely easy for you.

I personally enjoyed the HWs even though they were challenging because they were quite enjoyable to code up. However, I feel like most of my effort went into doing good style and docstrings. Sometimes we don't know about certain style requirements until after it was graded, especially at the end unless you asked the TAs. Final was hard, but curved

Professor Kaur has really good lectures. The programming assignments are long and you can lose a lot of points because of poor style (especially at the semester start), but since there's so much lecture/feedback form extra credit it's easy to get full credit. Tests are really hard and worth a ton but there are practice tests posted, so study a lot!

Professor Kaur is a great teacher, and her lectures are engaging and informative. The tests are difficult, but are often heavily curved. The TAs are helpful, but their grading can be inconsistent. If you attend lectures, study, and don't use AI to generate your code, you will do well. Beware of using outside material, because it's an automatic zero

Amrita is difficult to talk to and is not very helpful during office hours. Assignment grading is largely based on style instead of code functionality and the TAs take off points harshly for minor mistakes. Not a bad class if you have prior coding experience, but be sure not to use any of it because you'll be accused of cheating.

She was decent. As a lecturer she was pretty energetic, but I do think that she skimmed over a few stuff. The grading in the class is not very well-designed, as weekly assignments take up around 20 hours a week, but are worth less than 10% of your total grade. Exams are kind of brutal.
Shout out to Ms Kaur for her six seven jokes
Very smart professor who's very experienced in what she teaches but her class is not for the weak. Lectures are very fast paced but slides are posted to look back on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was challenging, and the exams had many questions that were hard to prepare for because they were extremely conceptual. However, she is a pretty good lecturer and explains the concepts pretty well. She also gives you a ton of practice tests to prepare for the exam, but they are Mike Scott's, so be aware they will be kinda different.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amrita is amazing! As someone with zero CS knowledge coming into the course, I found it to be very enjoyable. She's an engaging lecturer and if you attend lecture, it can count towards your final grade making the final worth less. You can't use prior CS knowledge so pay attention to what she does/doesn't talk about. Tests are fine. Lovely course!

Professor Kaur is incredibly rude and accuses you of cheating instantly. She has harsh grading criteria that does not reflect how much you know the material. She is a decent lecturer but she is difficult to talk to and very judgemental.

extremely harsh grading policies, expecting you to use only what's in the slides, even if it's the most basic topics. gives 0 on homeworks very often for alleged AI allegations & going out of syllabus & is not approachable for questions. not willing to reason or give even partial credit. extremely long unncessary assignments. DONT TAKE HER!!!

1) Doesn't teach 'break' and 'continue', yet teaches a much higher difficulty topic of object-oriented programming. Does it sound off to you? It should.
2) She will be getting your grade down to 0 if you dare to confront her. Has too many good reviews because bad ones have rude words in them, and oh they are deserved.
3) Not approachable at all
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While she's particular about some aspects of the class, she made a challenging subject manageable and even enjoyable. Lectures provide nearly all the info you need to know, and there are a lot of resources and extra credit opportunities. Some assignments were hard, but office hours were really helpful and grading/feedback was very clear.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Overall this was a good class. I definitely learned a lot without it being too hard. However, it's definitely not easy and the assignments are a bit of a pain especially with the code hygiene and style. Tests are definitely big but you get a lot of practice tests so make sure to use those.

She's a very nice teacher but the whole class is graded by the TAs, and they will destroy your grade. They are outrageously nitpicky on homeworks and the tests. Getting your code to work is the easy part. Assignments, FOCUS ON YOUR STYLE. Tests, there's a curve but it's not crazy, focus on studying over how the code works.

She's a decent lecturer but the grading structure is chopped. Your entire grade is dictated by tests (84%) and there's just about no curving. Even so, assignments are time-consuming and graded very harshly, and at times, seemingly arbitrarily. There *are* lots of extra-credit for assignment points to make up for it but it's mostly attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the worst, not the best. Exams/assignments are doable but have to be SO careful to not use concepts that haven't been taught (even if you have prior knowledge), or you will be accused of AI and get a 0 full stop. She doesn't communicate well about schedule/assignment changes etc. Grading criteria is VERY dependent on which TA grades your work.
someone said tests are the D-Day landings on Normandy beach from Saving Private Ryan lol and they are right

this class was genuinely so hard for no reason, and the CONSTANT AI allegations tank your grade bc she'll give anyone a 0 if you use a concept she didn't teach - even if you already knew it and truly didn't use AI. she's also hard to get in touch and midterm/finals(all are difficult) are worth basically your entire grade so if you fail, its over
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: dont take her...save yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BIOCHEM MAJORS GOOD LUCK...this class is so much work for no reason and your grade is determined by very few assignments / midterms so EVERYTHING matters. so strict on grading and if assignments didn't exactly match her rubric/style, she'd take off points. midterms are pretty difficult and lectures are her talking at you the entire time - AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Good teacher, but TRASH grading scheme. It is MEANT to SCREW you. Spend 25 hours on the weekly assignment? Its not even worth 1% of your grade lol. Didn't do the assignment correctly? Well if you don't redo it you get knocked 1/3 of an ENTIRE LETTER. 


How about tests? Oh yeah, 84% of your grade. Say good bye to any hopes of an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are the D-Day landings on Normandy beach from Saving Private Ryan
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Known as the 67 professor for a reason

Lectures were very great. Like others said, many jokes including the classic 67 to keep students engaged. The only reason I gave 4 was because we are always a bit behind so stuff gets crammed near the end, but that isn't any type of deal breaker and the class is very fun.
Makes students laugh during every lecture at least 6 or 7 times. Great teacher. Hard exams so make sure to study prior and do all the practice tests.

Amrita is one of the best professors in UT! Her homework assignments are kinda graded harshly, but you can easily get help from TAs and prof during office hours. Exams are straightforward with generous gradings.
One of the most FUNNY lectures I have ever seen. One lecture she made a backtracking tree with the faces of our other professors as the nodes. Also as others said, makes 6 or 7 jokes
Makes 67 jokes

Amrita is very knowledgeable and a decent lecturer, although lectures are entirely too quick. However, the AI accusations are entirely unjust, unfair, and impossible to deal with. If you turn in YOUR code, there's a possibility you'll be accused of AI, reported, and just in awe. Talking to Amrita is impossible. Genuinely, take another professor.

so i did have to schedule a therapy session abt this class because i got an unecessaery 0 on my assignment like i know it was bad but it definitely wasnt that bad. she said it was ai and it wasnt bc i did create the code in 20 minutes and ik it was bad but i got a 0 because it was ai... not cause it was bad. period!!!! tell em girl! i love that!
Average lecturer, not very friendly and snarky at times.
do not take this professor if you can lol

Very compassionate and caring person. Lectures are very funny and informative. Makes 67 jokes. You get to learn lots of new stuff. I say this taking her class again next semester, so that says a lot. 


Get ready to be humbled by those exams though. Make sure to study TWO WEEKS BEFORE as the grading can be unforgiving. No curve 1st & 2 pts 2nd exam

don't be discouraged by all the negative reviews, amrita is a very engaging professor. Lectures can be long with many slides, but she posts condensed slides and homework's and similar to in class problems and exams are similar to practice exams. Pay attention in lecture, attendance  optional based on final exam grade weight. some homework's long.

Evil. Accuses you of cheating if you use any outside knowledge, even if you have prior coding experience. Looks for reasons to take off points on tests and assignments, and doesn't post any grades until after the drop deadline has passed. Also gets mad if you ask a question, even though she is the one that tells us to ask questions. Do not take!

Amrita is wonderful, and I definitely recommend taking this course! I had zero CS experience prior to this course, but I found that not to be an issue. Amrita is fun, engaging, accommodating, and clearly puts lots of effort in. The tests are lengthy, but they are not very difficult if you pay attention to the lectures.

You only like her if you already know Python. If not, yikes. Lectures are 100+ slides long & very fast so you can't take notes or go back and look. No reviews. If you go to office hours she is rude & accuses everyone of cheating. She brags about how many reports she files. You will have to learn everything on your own. Tests handwritten on paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just not great... confusing, fast-paced lectures, not flexible at all with grading policies, and does not show much compassion towards students.

Amrita is very cold to her students and crashes out over small things like side talk (whispers) during class. Ends up causing a bigger distraction than it should. 


She can teach but I learned from practice tests mostly to get a 89 on the first test. 


Overall not bad, but if you need a supporting environment to learn this may not work out.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Professor can teach, but is not helpful when it comes to any questions. TAs were mostly the ones addressing needs of the students. I feel that she is very disconnected from her students.

She is VERY rushy with answering questions and doesn't delve into too much helpful detail. Not bad professor but Scott is nicer since I am retaking with him fall
This class is quite challenging, but she teaches it exceptionally well. UT doesn't seem to have a better professor for this course. You can genuinely learn the fundamentals of Python.

This professor talks extremely fast and is difficult to understand. She is not understanding if you bring any issue to her and will simply tell you to go talk to someone else. This class is hard but was so much tougher with this professor. Discussion & co-study were most helpful and I am thankful for that because I learned mainly from TAs.

She's a good lecturer and wants to make sure people understand the material, and is a very nice professor; however, look out for the exams as they are harder than the ones Professor Scott has, but still overall pretty good
Makes up random style guidelines where nobody knows what they are. Clearly has a terrible relationship with TAs.

Amrita's amazing and was a welcome change of pace from Ramsey. She's really energetic during lecture, and she's clearly passionate about the material. I don't think I'm alone in thinking her exams are more difficult that Mike Scott's. All three ended up getting curved during my semester. Past tests definitely won't fully prepare you.

Professor Kaur is perhaps the most engaging lecturer that I have encountered. I highly recommend going to lectures regularly. The course material is quite difficult, and expect to spend a great deal of time on every programming assignment (especially Huffman!) Our tests were substantially different from the practice exams, so I would prepare well.

Amazing + clear lectures. Don't use chat on assignments, you will 100% get caught. Exams are slightly different than Mike's but you'll do well if you study the lectures + not just take practice exams. Curved all the exams very generously. TA's are goated, go to help hours, co-study, + section. Didn't open the txbk, lectures are all you need.

i'm not a freshman & have retaken a few cs classes at ut. came in with no experience, and this was the first time i could really follow lecture and feel like i understood well. i'm a slow learner, but amrita made things click. the class is VERY hard, but she's a great prof. don't cheat on hw, ask tas for help, and study for exams, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: nice professor, nice ta's, somewhat fun lectures. assignments are time-consuming, so start early. lots of extra credit just for attending lectures, so even a few points off each assignment doesn't affect you at all. however, the MCQ part of the exams is extremely different from previous years, so be ready. textbook isn't mandatory, but it's helpful
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amrita truly loves CS and her students, she's a young but talented professor and brings lots of energy to the classroom. The difficulty of the class comes from the material itself, not the professor; this has been taught in the same way for 20 years. Exams weighed 84%, down from 90% w/ Mike last sem (& don't cheat on assignments, you'll get caught)

Her lectures are long, but her passion for CS is very evident. No phones are allowed in class, and she does say a few snappy remarks if you are seen lying on your hand or with a phone out (basically not being attentive). Exams are also heavily weighted, but studying is your best friend.

She is genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. The class is about 80 something percent based on tests and her tests are nothing like the previous professors tests (which is the ONLY study material provided). Beyond that she was never on pace with what we should've been learning at the time of the test. She is extremely mean and uncaring!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: We got a little bit behind which meant that harder topics were covered in short periods, but otherwise lectures were great and resources available helped a lot. I went to every co-study session. The amount of practice exams and problems given during section helped a lot.

Lectures were amazing and attendance was extra credit which made it easy. Even though I did say the class was test heavy, there were insane curves which helped a lot. Overall, the assignments held very specific and clear grading standards that left little room for ambiguity or argument. The exams were crazy hard but definetly worth the challenge.

I loved Amrita. Excellent lectures. Exams weren't too difficult, maybe 6/10. Most gripes about this class will come from people who did not want to study and/or ChatGPT warriors. I have no point of reference against Mike Scott, but I think Amrita took the job and ran with it. The grading scale is tough, deal with it.

Fairly difficult class, but entirely manageable with enough time. Exams were the worst part as they never matched the practice reviews and were on  paper, but were allowed a cheat sheet and allowed 2 on the final. Weekly assignments took a good deal of time but they're never that bad as long as you use the concepts she teaches to avoid getting a 0.

She grades so weird and I'll get a 0 on an entire assignment for using something that wasn't learned in class even though I learned it watching youtube videos over the concepts she went over. She made me never want to go to class and I genuinely can't stand computer science anymore. Also all of the tests are by hand in a computer science class.
Difficult but manageable - great professor

Prof. Kaur is a great lecturer and engaged with the students during and outside of class. Attendance is "mandatory" since you can complete the attendance ticket after 1 or 2 days after the lecture by watching the recording. The assignments aren't difficult and she gives you resources to prepare yourself for her exams. I encourage you to go OH :)

She is a fantastic lecturer, and super engaging. Gave a feedback survey for extra credit asking how long the assignments took and what we thought. She read these responses and considered what they said, sometimes slowing down lectures if requested. The exams were a fair assessment of what we had learned. Not easy, but not ridiculously hard.

This class moves VERY fast, but Prof. Kaur is so passionate in what she does and actually listens to her students if they ask to slow lecture down a bit. Assignments can be challenging, and she doesn't put up with disrespect, but she is overall super caring and wants the best for her students. Also gives out amazing practice materials. Do the PSS!

I came into this class with zero coding experience and never felt at a disadvantage. Professor Kaur knows her stuff, makes class fun, and upholds standards while practicing empathy. I felt her grading policies were challenging yet forgiving. Assignments can be tricky but grading is generous as long as you follow her academic honesty policies.

read all of this. I'll start by saying she is an amazing teacher, just not a good professor. She's really fun in class, but she loves handing out zeros on her homework assignments, which is hard to come back from. I enjoyed the class before we were given back our homework grades (1 month after submitting!), but she was not helpful after that.

Kaur is not a good prof. Her TA's grade super harshly, and her grading is so shady. She just does everything by hand and hands out grades randomly all at once without being able to see a clear breakdown. Some assignments are weighted more heavily than others, which ones? I have no freaking clue. Please don't take her or this class and save yourself

She talks very fast, her accent is hard to comprehend, and her grading is insane. She takes away significant points for the slightest mistakes. The practice tests are supposed to help, but they don't as the tests given are a lot harder. The final exam was an absolute nightmare.

Came in to Professor Kaur's class w/ minimal coding experience. Practice exams and lecture slides (esp the examples she includes in them) were very helpful for the exam. Homework was easy to follow along and not very difficult. Final was difficult, but she was lenient with the cutoffs so 40% of her class made A/A-. Very generous with extra credit!!

Before Professor Kaur's class, I had no coding experience, so office hours were very helpful. Coding is tough, so start assignments early. She's great - encourages participation with candy, offers extra credit, and cares about students. She's blunt but only when addressing disruptions. Study ahead, understand the concepts, and exams are curved.
