Angulo is the best prof i've ever, and probly will ever have. very clear and easy powerpoints, tests are straight from notes and text, eaaasy and interesting writing assignments. psych is pretty straightforward regardless of the prof but from what i heard about other psych profs Angulo's class sounded much better

Overall, very nice person and amazingly clear grading criteria. The first two exams are pretty close to each other and require a bit of work to understand, but she gives lots of materials to prepare. Towards the end of the class, homeworks felt more like busy work than anything, but still very helpful to studying for final. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is my unicorn. Her lectures were always well prepared and easy to follow. I always felt comfortable asking my questions in class, and she was also accessible outside of class. I genuinely believe she cared about me, and she graded a lot of work with individualized comments, which I appreciated.

Dr. Hager is the most involved professor I had during my time at UT. She is absolutely rooting for students to get an A in her class and makes it very possible to do so. Attendance is required once every week or so for the in person assignments, but I'd say to go as often as you can because she'll give hw answers in lecture!
Such a warm person. She is so kind, so passionate, and really wants to make sure her students learn and understand. Read the reviews, take this class for an easy math core.

hager gives a lot of resources throughout the year (hw, textbook questions, in class practice, test reviews) for you to succeed. would recommend going to class as much as possible for proper understanding of the material. pretty content heavy after midterm 2, but doable if you keep up with hw and do the final exan review. overall, def recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: hager is amazing. she obviously cares a lot and makes sure you understand the harder discrete topics. would highly recommend going to class, problems are given each day that help understanding. exams are straightforward and she makes it clear what you need to write down to do well. even gives study guides!

this class was super easy, engaging and really fun. there's one homework assignment due weekly, and maybe 2 or 3 mini quizzes to go with it (but you get as many attempts to do them and only your highest score is taken) even the homework is super easy, she gives us answers to half the questions. definitely take this class for your math credit!

Professor Hager's class is a breeze - the weekly homework is manageable, and attendance isn't mandatory. Plus, she makes the lectures fun and engaging. I found Unstuck ai really helpful for exam prep in this class.

Dr. Hager was amazing. She made the material interesting and easy to understand, and spent lots of time answering questions for people who needed it. Homework is easy and you get a notes sheet for exams. I would take another class with her if I could!
Very understanding if you don't understand the material.
read the other reviews and take this class. enough said.

Dr. Hager's class is THE BEST. If you're looking for an easy class to take for your math credit, M 302 is the right one to take. Weekly homework assignments take about an hour, and attendance isn't mandatory, so it is really low maintenance while learning a lot! There is a midterm and a final, but you get a notes sheet, so it's pretty easy!

Hager Slayyyys. Homework is due every week with roughly 12 questions. Half of them are discussed in lecture and the rest are easily answered in office hours. She is super funny and creates a great environment to learn. While most of her students are non-STEM she makes the class a breeze with only 2 Exams.

Dr. Hager is simply amazing. She is by far one of the best professors at UT. She genuinely cares about her students' success, and helps them understand math in fun ways. She is very available outside of class, and her office hours are the best! If I could take her for every course I would!

I love Dr. Hager I wish she could teach every single class ever. She seems to be able to sense the class' mood about certain subjects and understands when things get difficult and will work accordingly. Plus attendance isn't mandatory at all.
Professor Hager is one of the few I had that really taught me how to understand math. She is attentive, respectful and is very good at keeping students interested in the topics!

I loved prof. hager! she always makes lectures interesting & fun & her slideshows were so funny w/ her pictures she uses! She's very straight forward, as long as u pay attention to the material, u will have no problem in this class. Personally, I went to the lectures simply bc enjoyed them, but you absolutely don't have to go! Take this class!

She was an amazing professor! Although the class's content may be difficult at times she made it seem very easy. If I could take this professor again no matter the class I would. Genuinely, one of the best professors I have had at UT. Attendance to classes was not mandatory because she records them and posted notes for them online.
She is truly one of the best professors I have ever had. She genuinely cares about the success of her students which is rare. I highly recommend taking her as a math professor!! 10/10

I took this class through UT's university extension to get into ECH at UT instead of passing the Calculus AB/BC AP tests. Was it worth it? Yes. Would I do it again? No. 
I took 15 credit hours from UTPB and then did 408C. This class was HARD through its grading system. I still accepted the credit but now know to do 408D in person. [Fall 2022]
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hagar was wonderful! She had engaging lectures and clearly explained all topics. She made herself easily available for any students that needed extra help and would often give us class time to go over homework questions. She allowed us to make a cheat sheet to use on exams. Lowest exam grade was dropped. Great professor!

TAKE THIS IF YOU HATE MATH AND NEED CREDIT! This is the easiest math I have ever taken. Hager is a great professor and really funny. She knows most of us hate math and tailors class to that. Weekly homework, 3 tests. Highly recommend!!!

I loved taking Dr. Hager's class! She's so easy to talk to and makes the lectures fun. She knows a lot of students aren't math people and she definitely caters to that. She's very busy with life stuff but does her best to make herself available for homework help. 3 exams but takes the 2 highest. Homework due every week but not very difficult

TAKE THIS FOR A MATH CREDIT! easiest intro to math class ever, i hate math and i loved this class. Hager is amazing, understanding and funny. 2 tests, usually open note, 1 hw a week, super easy, and 1 quiz a week you can re take however many times you want. she's really engaging and sweet and is flexible on deadlines.
Her Plan II Math class made math... actually fun?! She is always there to support her students, is super entertaining in class, and works hard to make sure everyone can succeed.

Dr. Hager is the best! I need Intro to Math to complete a flag requirement, and she made it so easy. There were three different ways to attend class or learn the material, and everything was very well explained. She's very understanding, and eager to help.

Hager is an incredible professor; intelligent, passionate, flexible, and always willing to help. The concepts are tricky with abstract geometry and brain teasers. However, she breaks them down nicely, and you will be able to understand them. Super flexible with attendance, and assignments are fairly short and easy. Office hours are great. Easy A!

Dr. Hager is a really good professor and you can tell that she cares about her students. She was really good about making sure that everyone understands the material and will get good grades. Tt is basically impossible for you to fail this class if you go to lectures!

Professor Hager is a wonderful person and professor. Her class was very engaging, and I truly learned so much in this course. The workload was perfect for learning the material, and I felt that if I ever needed help with a lesson, I could get it. I encourage anyone that has the opportunity to take this class to take it.

Professor Hager has truly been one of the best teachers/people I have met at UT thus far. I took M302 as a comm major for my math credit, and it was the best experience. Professor Hager offers her class in person, on zoom, and recorded, and the way she teaches makes you feel excited to learn and apply the skills she teaches.

Dr.Hager was amazing! Took her M302 class in the Spring of 2022 and had a great experience. She makes math for non STEM and business majors very easy. Tests were open note and OPEN INTERNET-- she even openly said we could call on other students for help! I highly recommend Dr.Hager for this course!

Dr. Hager is easily one of the best professors I've had at UT. She is extremely helpful when you have questions about the homework, especially during office hours!! If you need a math credit, definitely take her class. I can't recommend her enough!

Dr. Hager is amazing and makes lectures enjoyable. The material can be kind of tough, especially the first few weeks of class,. However, going to office hours for homework helps a lot and Dr. Hager makes sure she clears up any confusion. Homework is due everyweek, but if you get her to check it before it is due you will get a good grade.

Dr. Hager dumbed complicated math concepts down but didn't make me feel like a kindergartener. She has this fantastic way of explaining things that you get it on the first try. Even the puzzles that seem impossible at first will become so clear after she goes through it with you once.

Dr. Hager is one of the best professors I've ever had at UT. I took her online async class last fall. If you need math credit, take Dr. Hager's M302 class! The office hours were helpful to ask questions and she went over homework questions each week. As long as you put effort, you'll get a good grade. I would definitely take this class again!

SHE IS AN ANGEL! She'll teach u extremely advanced concepts and you won't even realize it. She makes hard things understandable--it's like magic! She's kind and patient like no other professor I've seen! Def go to office hours to get help with homework. Weekly homeworks+ some exams (very doable, just do your work on time & an A is achievable)
Stellar professor! I don't particularly like math, but I still enjoyed her class thoroughly.

*COVID, asynchronous online course* If you're not great at math and want to get M302 over with a great standing grade then Dr. Hager is the one. Every week there's a lecture or two, quiz, and homework, and everything is due on that Friday. Also, she and her TA's are VERY helpful with ANY questions you may have! Definitely recommend!

Took this class online because of COVID and it was the best decision I ever made. She made the class super interesting and fun and the work was easy to understand with the explanation videos she does instead of a lecture. Take this class if you can, I honestly wish there was a part II because I would take any class with her again.

I'm not a math person at all, but this class is super easy! It's asynchronous so you can choose when to do your work. Office hours are extremely helpful. HAGER IS AMAZING!!! She's super accommodating and always answers questions in the groupme. She is also hilarious and always gives me a good laugh during office hours. I HIGHLY recommend this class

Dr. Hager is one of the best and coolest professors I have ever had. She truly cares about her students and is passionate about what she does. During the COVID-19 semester she was extremely understanding. The class is not extremely difficult but still very engaging. Whether you need a math credit or not TAKE HER simply because she is so awesome!

Dr. Hager is literally the best professor I've ever had! She is the funniest and more caring teacher I have ever had and is very loving towards her students. If you are looking for a EASY and BREEZY Math class then you definitely shoudl take Hager's course. Although it may seem at bit challenging at first, group projects and tests help a lot.

There's not enough space in this text box to say how amazing Professor Hager is. Not only is she the best professor at UT, she might be the best professor in the history of the world. I've always hated math but she made it my favorite class. The lectures were always interesting and fun!! She really cares about all of her students! TAKE HER CLASS!!!

Dr. Hager is the best math professor you will ever have!! She teaches material in an interesting and exciting way, and will do everything in her power to help you understand the concepts. If you get the chance to take her M302 class, take it!!! She is just fantastic, and by the end of the class, you might find that you actually enjoy math!

Dr. Hager is one of the best professors I've taken. Her lectures are optional since she posts things online but if you really want to understand what will be in the tests and weekly homeworks, it is best to show up. The tests are written and are not difficult as long as you study with the reviews she gives out. Definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Weekly HW. Lectures are posted. She is so nice and actually cares about her students. Her/TAs are super accessible. The book isn't required but provides diff ways to look at problems/topics. Exams are all written and not bad. There are also 3 written assignments - GET A TA TO LOOK AT IT b4 submitting. Content is more logic/geometric than math.

Hager is amazing. So caring and wants her students to succeed. Also takes the time to make sure everyone understands her explanations and will explain it differently if you don't. I've never had a more genuine professor. She made the online transition so easy and was always available for questions and to help us out. Would recommend her to anyone.

Dr. Hager was such an amazing professor. She makes the class easy to understand for everyone. I recommend taking math with her! She does give weekly homework, and three exams with a final. But she will always leave you prepared and goes over any questions on the homework before it is dues.

I thought Hager was a great teacher, and she is very caring and understanding. I still struggled with the material, expecting it to be traditional math. This class is logic based math which isn't hard if you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Hager is just the kind of person you want to be your professor during a global pandemic. There's just no way I could possibly convey her awesomeness. She's caring, her lectures are interesting, she's fun, and very accessible. She is by far the best professor I've had at UT and I'd encourage anyone to take her class.

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Hager! I took this class only because I needed a math credit for my degree plan, and this was the first math class I've ever enjoyed. She is so caring and her lectures are short and sweet. A lot of her class isn't "traditional" math, and she makes the concepts accessible and is always there if you need help!

LOVED her so so much, highly recommend her. She made the class seem so easy and if you got to class and take notes you dont need the textbook!! She's really funny and relatable in class and will make sure every single person understands the material. Would take any math class I can with her, also wants you to score well

Dr. Hager is the best at making the material simple enough for anyone to understand. Attendance not necessarily required but you won't want to miss lectures because she teaches so well. If you show up everyday and complete the assignments, you will do well. The absolute sweetest prof I've had and her office hours are super helpful.

Professor Hager is amazing. She is so helpful-- by far one of the best professors I have ever had. The class can be tricky at times, but she genuinely wants to see you succeed and will do what it takes to help you!!

She's the BEST teacher I've had. The class is fascinating and she is wonderful. I do think that although attendance is not mandatory, going to class or not will affect your understanding of the topics significantly, it is not information you can self teach or find online.

Dr Hager is one of the best professors at UT. She genuinely cares for her students and answers any questions. If you are not good at traditional math courses, then this is the course for you. It isnt easy, but so much help is offered to you that its hard not to pass. Show up to class, its the respectful thing to do bc dr Hager is amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: As a liberal arts major, I was totally expecting to struggle and barely get a B, but the class was AMAZING. Hager is absolutely hilarious, so despite the fact that lectures aren't mandatory (you get some hw answers at times, though), I recommend going just to hear her jokes. It's not your typical math class, though--concepts are very abstract.

I made a 100 on every test even the final. Hager goes really slow through the topics and is very easy to understand. Only thing I didn't like about her was that she was a little TOO easy, kind of felt like I was in elementary school. High school level course in my opinion.

Don't let me corrupt you, but I didn't go to a single class except for exams and squeezed a 90, and I'm not even "good at math". This did make the homework tough but she posts notes and videos and drops the 4 lowest! Though a pretty easy class w/ a good teacher, it's logic based and CONCEPTUAL so don't take this if you struggle with abstract ideas.

She's amazing. Had her for pre-calculus and it was a very easy A. Weekly quizzes at discussion, one gets dropped, but the quiz material is covered at discussion literally 10 minutes before. Take notes, do the homework, you'll get A's on all her exams. Great professor

I absolutely loved Hager! She is such a sweetheart, naturally funny, and teaches in an interesting way. Since all the exams are based on homework, I almost never went to class and still got a high A! Best class for liberal arts majors who are stressing about math, and if you do go to class, you won't have any trouble with the material :)

Attendance for lectures is not mandatory, but going is extremely helpful! There's weekly quizzes in discussion, but they're very easy and extremely short, if you go to lecture and take good notes you'll do well. She's very approachable and always wants to help students. Loved her!
Dr. Hager has been on of my favorite professors. If you don't like math or have difficulties with it, take this class!! You will actually learn and enjoy it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's a very good professor and is very sweet to students. If you struggle with math take her because she will take her time to deeply explain a problem to you. She will show you why a certain rule is "illegal" in math instead of just telling you it's not possible. She is an AMAZING professor!

I LOVED Dr. Hager's class and wish she could be my calculus professor! She is super understanding, sweet, and caring. I took her pre-calculus class after taking precal AND calculus in high school, and I'm so glad I did! I *actually* learned from Dr. Hager and genuinely enjoyed going to her lectures. She is interactive and always trying to improve.

If youre a liberal arts major and are scared to take math TAKE HAGER !! she is awesome at explaining things in a humble way that makes her very approachable ! You dont even need to buy the physical textbook because all you need are the homework problems. She goes over everything in class and sometimes the homeworks too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Hager is an incredible teacher. She explains difficult topics very well. The quizzes during discussion are very easy, and the TA will cover the important parts before you take the quiz. I skipped one or two classes a week and just learned from the quest modules. She gives you a lot of prep material for the tests. Highly recommend this class

Hager is an absolute sweetheart and one of my favorite professors at UT. She clearly enjoys teaching math and wants her students to learn. Her tests are very doable and similar to her Quest homeworks.

She is SUCH a sweetheart. This class was extremely easy as long as you show up to class and do the homework (which isn't very much). I put in minimum effort and was able to snag an A without any trouble. Cheers!

Dr. Hager is a great professor that gives all of her students a chance to succeed. Even while she was pregnant she attempted to be as available and kind as possible. I would recommend everyone to take this class as their 305G class. It is great and Dr. Hager as a true passion for mathematics.

Hager is one of the best professors at UT. She is clear, thorough, goofy, and very funny. If I could have her be my professor for every math class for the rest of my life, I'd be very content. It's okay to skip a few lectures here and there, but I'd recommend being there most of the time. Quizzes and tests are easy, but it's not a total blowoff.

Professor Hager is an amazing math professor. I had her for precal (with pre cal and calc experience already) and this class is not that hard. Ask questions and participate in class. Also use piazza bc it gives you a bonus point on your average if you participate enough. The tests are not too bad, just do the sample exams
Professor Hager was AWESOME! She has a goofy and friendly personality, and made me enjoy/appreciate math. HIGHLY recommend.
I. Love. Dr. Hager. Seriously, I hate math and she made math fun. She explains things so well and her lectures are enjoyable because she makes jokes and great analogies to describe things. Take her!!

Before taking Dr. Hager, I was in M408N and decided to drop it due to a horrible worthless professor Evelyn Schultz. I decided to go back and take M305G Precal. Best choice i ever did. Dr. Hager will really prepare for taking calculus here at UT. She was so nice, patient, funny, and caring to her students. Her exams are all fair. TAKE HER!!!!

Hands down one of the best professors at UT. Goes above and beyond for her students. Will help you no matter what and will always make people feel welcome. Her lectures are amazing also. 3 exams, 1 final. Easy quiz every week. Homework every week also. If you do bad on one exam, it doesn't get dropped. But your final grade can replace that exam.

Dr. Hager has 3 exams and a final. The format is half multiple choice and free response. The free section is worth more than the multiple choice. Final is the same with but allowed an notecard. She is very kind and actually cares for her students. She has office hours and is willing to help you if you have accommodations. homework is also in discus

Amanda Hager is one of the best professor at UT. Her lectures are really simple to follow and she will stop and go over the material if you don't get it. The homework consists of quest and some book homework. 1 quest homework and book homework a week. 3 tests and a final. Study for the tests by studying the homework. Great professor!! Easy A!

Dr. Hager is my favorite professor of all time! She was so charming and hilarious during lecture while still thoroughly going over the material. Her teaching style was clear and concise. She prepared well for the exams and even held review sessions. I don't have a single negative comment because she truly was a gem! Take her, you'll thank me later!
I loved Dr. Hager! She is amazing and takes the time to actually learn your name. She's a real gem!

Professor Hager is an awesome professor! I'm not a fan of math but she makes it an enjoyable experience! It was in a large lecture class but it seems so intimate because of her teaching method. Hw due once a week, 2 lowest dropped. Reviews for all the tests. 3 tests and then there is a final. I would highly recommend her she is just fantastic!

Dr. Hager is a wonderful person. She is so quirky and cute and has such a great personality. She genuinely cares about her students and their success in her class and will learn everyone's name. If you've taken a pre-calc or calculus course before, this class is very easy and manageable.

Dr. Hager is awesome! She is so laid back, funny, and makes everything easy to understand. If you go to class, do the HW on quest, and do the exam guidance before each exam then you should be able to get a good grade. She wants you to do well in her class and I would take her again if I could!!

Two types of homework due every week, along with three exams and one final. If your final grade is higher than any of the previous exam grades, she will replace that grade. As a result, your final is worth 40% of your grade.  She is a supportive teacher and encourages class participation. I would love to have her as a math teacher again.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's good professor. Very helpful. There is homework due every Thursday but usually not too bad. Tests are easy as well, just stay on top of the homework problems and you'll be good and beware of the written section. She is always super happy in class and always seeks to help students in any way she can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Hager is the best professor I had during my freshman year. There is a extra credit opportunity that is worth 1 % added to your final course grade by using Piazza frequently. On the last day of class, she gave us 2 points on our final exam just by showing up. She is an amazing lecture and really nice. There is HW due every week. I love her!!!!!!

I absolutely loved having Dr. Hager as a math professor! Even though she teaches precal to a huge lecture hall, she is excellent at engaging the entire class.  Even if you sit at the back, she will come up there and help you! She is truly amazing at teaching math.  This class isn't easy, but if you will put in the work, you will be very pleased.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Hager is an amazing person and a mentor. She will explain everything to you until you get the materials. Also, her exams and expectations are not hard at all. If you come prepared learning, complete your homework on time, and do what you are supposed to, you will be golden!

Dr. Hager is amazing! This class is not an "easy A," but she will teach you so much, you'll be so proud of the work you do! I have learned so much from this professor. My experience in Dr. Hager's class has proved invaluable to my life and I am so grateful I got to take her! TAKE HAGER!!!

BEST math prof ever.  Enthusiastic, kind, and genuinely cares for her students! Not easy though.  Makes you work for it, but her teaching style is easy to understand and her lectures are NEVER boring.  Take Hager!!! I promise you won't regret it.

Truly amazing professor.  She definitely cares about her students and is willing to do anything to help them learn.  She welcomes questions and is always patient in answering them -- even if the question has been asked 5 times already.  She is so great! I wish I could take her for all my math classes.

Dr. Hager really cares about her students and is extremely helpful with the homework. You have a lot of ways to get in contact with her, whether it be through piazza, email, or online office hours. The material in this class is a nice refresher of high school pre-cal, and definitely prepares you for calculus.

Pretty basic math class. Dr. Hager was super nice and tried to connect with all her students. I even missed the final because of a calendar/canvas mishap and she ended up letting me take it the next day. She's pretty chill and usually knows what shes talking about.

Dr. Hager is one of the most nicest and greatest math professor here at UT. After failing two midterms (both grades in the 50's), I went into office hours and ask for help. Hager worked with me on concepts I was struggling in and how to actually study for a math class here at UT. Working with Dr. Hager, I ended up making a B- in the class.

I was never good at math and what I love about Dr. Hager is her patience and passion toward math, she will never make you feel like a burden when you have a concern or question regarding the material! Her passion makes you want to learn math with her, even if it gets tough as long as you're willing to meet her halfway she will get you through! (:

Amanda is by far the best professor in the math department. She is so nice and cares so much for her students. Her exams are not hard at all if you attend class and do your homework. Exams are quest based with a few free response questions. I took her for M305G AND M408N and it was a great experience. She's amazing.

Professor Hager is amazing! She is so sweet and her lectures are really engaging. She does a great job at explaining all of the material and you'll never feel lost because she's super open to questions during class. There is weekly homework, but it's very easy and she helps you on it the day before it's due. LOVED this class- so interesting! (:

Dr. Hager is an amaaaaaazing Pre-Calc professor! Shes always perky and cheerful and gladly welcomes questions in class. She stops and explains concepts several times until a majority of the class understands. HW assignments are quest based and are fairly easy. Easiest exams I have take in my 19 years of existence. TAKE HER, DUDE.
Best math teacher at UT. Took her for Preparation for calculus and her calculus I class. Both very easy and her test are not bad at all! She's the best take her!!!
Great math professor, very friendly, very helpful.  Lots of homework and tests are graded strictly but it's manageable.

She is a great teacher. Her exams can be hard if you don't study!  Learn how to do every  Quest homework problem and you should be fine. I would recommend her class, she's the best and nicest math professor at UT.

I really enjoyed this class. Dr. Hager is a great teacher who really cares about her students. She will answer any questions and give good explanations. She interacts with students, and I was always very engaged.

We have a short quiz every discussion section, but they're pretty easy imo. The tests are not very difficult. It's pretty similara tiny bit harder than hw problems. As long as you take good notes, understand what's going on, and do your hw. . .you should be fine. I didn't buy the textbook.

she has a hard time explaining difficult concepts in different ways, but all in all she is an ok professor, she just needs more skill in the department of doing example problems that are easy and giving homework that is more difficult than the practice examples in class. don't take if you are a non liberal arts major, you won't be ready for calc.

Do not take this professor. She tends to rush through material way too fast and when a question is asked she gives a vague answer that does not make any sense. Also dont expect help on homework, she will not explain the problems in detail but will just give you a brief lib of what you did wrong... which does not help.. Not the best math professor.

Dr. Hager is by far the best professor to take for math at UT. She cares so much about her students progress and will make sure the class understands the concepts. She's not doing the traditional "flipped classroom" like most math classes do. She actually teaches! Test can be hard only if you don't study!

It was an absolute pleasure having Amanda as my professor. Granted, this class was not calculus, but still confusing at times. She was always helpful, explained things in depth and most of all was so warm and kind that it made office hours and class enjoyable. More professors should be like Amanda.

Professor Hager takes pre-cal and breaks it down into simple terms that anyone can understand. At times her class seemed childish, but I came out with a solid set of algebra skills. She is very energetic and bubbly, like a cute little nerdy math lady. But don't let this fool you, she is also a bodybuilder in her free time! Great prep for calculus.

She is a nice and bubbly person but she is not very good at explaining concepts and she also zips through the material way too fast for almost anyone to understand. The flipped classroom style that she uses is not beneficial because during class she does not actually teach but she only does practice problems which are not very helpful. Don't take!
She's such a great professor!!! i would recommend taking her class! She is awesome and he quizzes and test are not that hard as long as you study!
She is such a nice professor but her test are HARD! I would constantly work homework problems and still managed to make low c's on the test.
She is awesome! take her. Her homework is kinda hard but she puts the easy problems on the test. take her!!!!
Hard to understand lectures, she moves too fast through concepts without explanation.
she's a horrible lecture and professor. I learned everything by myself. I would not recommend her prep for calculus class. waste of time and she's really annoying in class also.

Dr. Hager is great in her office hours! Tons of assignments and work though. Quest is unnecessarily difficult for how easy her tests are. She will usually let the class use note cards on tests if someone asks. She is a nice woman, knows her stuff, and is realistic about problems.

Dr Hager is the best math teacher I've ever had and the best calculus teacher at UT.  Thats all there is to it.  She genuinely cares about her students and there was not a single day that I didnt look forward to going to class. I didnt even do all that well in the class, but I learned a ton .

Did not like her. She was a horrible teacher but a nice person. She does care for her students but she can't teach without confusing half the class and her test are hard (quest based). I would recommend another teacher for math. She comes of more of an entertainer than a teacher

I was in Dr. Hager calculus class and I didn't like her. Yes she is really cool and funny but she cant teach! Her first exam is really easy but her 2nd exam is awful! class average was a 40. third exam was alright. what was dumb is we were doing our homework on my math lab but she made a test quest based. Don't recommend her for calculus

Dr. Hager is awesome.  She makes calculus much less intimidating than all other professors.  I loved everything about her class except the My Math Lab software we used.  Her tests can be a bit tricky as well but she will tell you everything you need to know in advance.  She cares about her students more than any other professor I've met at UT.

She is the definition of a teacher who simply loves whats she does. She interacts with the students and tries to create and more open, and fun learning environment. I loved her. 3 test, one final, really easy to ace test if you do the online reviews she post, instead of being lazy like me and not wanting too and accepting a B.
One of the two best professors I've had in three semesters and best math teacher I've had. Highly recommended whether you have trouble with math or not.

She's a funny gal. Her class is like a flipped classroom - learn through Quest modules and ask questions during class, something I didn't really like. She is super helpful and her tests are not hard at all. Quest and review worksheets are, but she basically picks the easier question types to put on the test!

Hager is one of the nicest happiest people I know. She really loves math and actually makes you want to go to class. I love that she remembers your name and is also pretty funny. Although the class was kind of difficult she makes it entertaining. Take her!

Dr. Hager is one of the funnest Calculus professors you can get! She makes lecture super entertaining and her tests are very easy. She makes you feel so comfortable, I was never afraid to ask any questions. If you want a fun and engaging calculus class, plus a good grade, take her!

Dr.Hager is the best math teacher I have ever had! She is very fun and energetic and enjoys teaching. She explains things very well, and although calculus is a challenging subject, she simplifies things and makes them easy to learn. She even goes out of her way to learn most of her students' names. I would definitely recommend her!

ridiculously unorganized. spent an entire lecture talking about the height of mountains. expect to learn everything on yourself because all you do during class is a worksheet. She does barely any examples, and makes a ridiculous amount of mistakes. Constantly asks the students "is that right?" More of an entertainer than a teacher.

Dr. Hager centers her lectures off of Quest Modules. She assigns homework about two weeks in advanced and it is very easy to follow, in class she is not very good at explaining, but in office hours she goes out of her way to make sure you understand. She is has a very cute and empathetic personality which makes the class fun.
2 tests and a final. very easy. she's very energetic and very nice. bookwork everyday, ugh. quest hw 2x/week.

Great prof! She includes diff activities/experiements during lecture to keep you engaged and she's knowledgeable and passionate abt food science. I'm not sure if this was j me tho, but she wasn't that accessible outside of class b/c she never responded to my emails, even those about accommodations

Professor Hays is a great professor and I enjoyed taking NTR 307 with her this semester. She is strict with attendance and uses squarecap, so if you miss class a lot, I wouldn't take this course. There is 1 major group project that she grades strictly. Outside of the project, there are 2 take home quizzes per week. Overall, I loved this class!

I had a passion for nutrition going into the course but she still had me so engaged. She taught a lot about critical thinking and scrutinizing diet culture. She is also a food scientist so she brings in some really interesting discourse about that as well. I really recommend that you take this class with her.

Not very accommodating and gives off political rants. She doesn't care if you pay attention in class, just as long as you attend. And is extremely passive-aggressive. I recommend just using the UT VPN, as it's a great workaround for the square cap assignment she does. It's just not a very inspiring class; if she did online exams, then maybe.

I loved having her as a professor! The lectures are always interesting and there are a lot of extra credit opportunities available throughout the semester. I'm applying so much of what I learned in my everyday life!
Speaking speed not too fast, use auto-subtitles, friendly for international students (especially new student), easy to understand. Course could be creative.

Professor Hays always wears cool outfits and brings good energy to class. While though our weekly take-home quizzes are kind of hard you should be fine as long as you pay attention in class. There are no exams but there is a final group project. Additionally, we take attendance through Squarecap but its counted as extra credit!

honestly, she's a pretty interesting professor, and the class material is great, but i'm not a morning person, and her lectures are at 9am in-person. there are occasional discussions she does in-class, but she doesn't announce them beforehand, so i've missed almost every single one, and she cancels class sometimes and doesn't announce it online.

Professor Hays knows how to make about nutrition interesting at 10am, awesome lecturer.  With extra credit given by just showing up to class, open note quizzes and exams, review days, and making it clear what will be on the exams, there is no way you shouldn't earn an A. Great class, actually able to apply the knowledge to my everyday life.

Drew is such a sweet and knowledgeable professor. The lectures were so informational, and she did such a good job to make this class interesting with guest speakers, extra credit assignments, and food-science experiments. Attendance is mandatory, there's a huge group project, and there are no exams- only weekly quizzes! Take her!

Professor Hays loves answering students' questions and gives a lot of extra credit. All of the assessments were open book and open note, so as long as you complete things on time, it should be pretty straightforward.

Professor Hays gives interesting lectures and is receptive to student questions. She also gives tons of extra credit throughout the semester to help you boost your grade, and the quizzes/exams are open book open note. She doesn't use the +/- system, so a 90 is an A. Overall, great professor!

Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives tons of extra credit during class (polls). There is an easy project where you analyze your own diet for a few days. If you print out the PPPs , skim the readings and have your notes ready you'll do well on the Quizzes and exams. She's really fun and explains well!! Great professor and an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Expectations in the class were very clear, and she offered so much extra credit for going to class. She was really willing to help you if you got confused over any of the material

Really easy A for intro food science. Grade determined by a group project, open note quizzes, and attendance taken via squarecap. Really funny lady and super knowledgeable and respected within her field.

Super fun class with a very awesome professor! She knows what she's talking about and does it in an entertaining way. There were 10 quizzes throughout the semester and a group project which was really fun and easy as long as you DON'T procrastinate. There's sooo much extra credit as well. I'm already looking into taking more classes with her.

This class was so fun and Drew is so nice and caring. Attendance is mandatory but the class is enjoyable so you will want to go. It is slightly different from Intro Food Science but I would take this class again. Getting an A is definitely doable.

This class is very straightforward, she explains instructions clearly and reminds you when things are due and warns you on what to study for the quizzes. If you refer to the chapters and keep up with the readings, it is and easy A. I enjoyed her lectures, they were very relatable. Final is optional if you did good through the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: this is an easy A and science credit. if you show up to class most likely you will get extra credit. there's one test the whole semester and it was so easy you don't even have to study. You can take quizzes outside of class with a group which is helpful. People have over a 100 as their end grade. Highly recommend.

she is so rude and sassy, but her class is so easy and she knows what she's talking about. the content is actually super interesting and i really enjoy going to class. she could make the test super hard since the material is complex, but she makes them SO easy. you can take quizzes as a group. gives a ton of extra credit. easy A.

Professor Hays is really respected in her field. However, I think she knows that summer classes just need the credit. The assignments are really easy. Everything is low stakes points. Extra credit is given in class through squarecap. Show up and listen, then do the application-based assignments. Take her over the other professor, for sure!

The class is very easy with enough extra credit to cover for an quiz/exam grade. The projects are basically completion and don't take too much time or effort. The quizzes are open note, but the quiz will consist of things she says that aren't on the powerpoints. Midterm and final are very similar to the reviews she gives the class period before.

Easy A. You have 6 quizzes that are worth 50 points (most of your grade) and a midterm and a final both worth 50 points. Easy projects. HEAVY EXTRACREDIT, go to class before the midterm and final and she will literally give u 45 extra credit points for the semester. Take the quizzes with someone if she lets you. Class gets easier with time!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: does not round grade at end of semester and does not follow +/- scale, quizzes suck and are a huge chunk of the grade, professor is rude and does not really care about you personally, she goes give extra credit for attendacn, lectures are boring
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had Hays fall semester and I loved her. She's quirky and knowledgeable about nutrition and her class was really interesting to take. She tries to keep lectures fun but they can drag a bit. Her tests were pretty easy. I skipped a lot of classes but still made it out with an A. Read the chp & go over her slides and you'll be fine! Optional final

6 quizzes that each weigh the same as the the midterm and final. the quizzes are timed and difficult if you're planning to take this class and not study like I did. Also, don't miss any of the quizzes, they cant be made up. I had to take a 0/50 because the Eagles won the super bowl and I forgot about real life for week

The class was extremely easy but Ms. Hays made it more difficult than it had to be. She doesn't allow makeup quizzes or exams (even with an excuse), she is very strict, and lectures can be a little boring. Difficult teacher, but she is passionate about what she teaches.

Great lecturer. Grades consist of projects, quizzes, and exams. Attendance is not mandatory, but she does unexpected extra credit on squarecap based on attendance. Quizzes are based on the chapters assigned that week. It's an easy read. Exams are based on her review she gives in class. No study guide given. Projects are simple; easy 100.

Had Dr. Hays for 307 last fall, and she's a fantastic instructor. Highly articulate and objective. She is very good at covering large expanses of material whilst maintaining the critical nuances. Her quizzes were very fair, I just wish they'd been open for a longer duration each day. Other than that, 307 with her is great - absolutely recommend!
Tests are straight from the textbook and powerpoint. I barely paid attention and I'd only start studying for the tests the night before and I still got an A in the class. Definitely recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Attendance isn't mandatory and she posts her slides up on canvas, however in lecture she says a lot of things that are not on the slides and will show up again on the test, so go to class. Also the textbook is not necessary, I mainly used it for clarification purposes. she gives extra credit and curves the test if there are unclear questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ms. Hays is very knowledgable and can seem intimidating, but she just wants her students to do well. Go to class everyday, participate, take notes on the lecture slides she posts to Canvas, make flashcards, and you'll get an A. The textbook is helpful, and will be needed for the lab anyways. She can be a little grumpy, but overall a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really don't know why Professor Hays doesn't have higher ratings, she is phenomenal! The class is test heavy. I pay attention, take notes, and make a Quizlet set after every class. Start studying the week before & you are fine! Haven't opened the textbook once, I just memorize lecture slides. I have learned so much from this course, TAKE HAYS!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Hays was amazing! Although she may seem intimidating at first, you'll quickly see that she is a very good professor. The workload is minimal - as long as you read and pay attention in class, you will do fine! Few, easy assignments. Hays gives quick, to-the-point lectures and often lets class out early. Really enjoyed the class.
Amazing professor
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's an awesome lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The course itself isn't hard, and Hays isn't necessarily bad at presenting her slides, BUT she doesn't provide many resources. She'll mention something the first day of class, never talk about it again and then it will be on the test. 50 question exams with obscure questions. She never reviews or helps you prepare for the test. Its literally on you
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Drew Hays was my professor for Food Science. She was really knowledgeable, and lectures were really fun. The first exam was so easy. The other 4 exams were insanely hard.  She might ask you something so specific that theres honestly no way you'd remember. She curves every test: GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS FOR EXAM HELP
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: she is the reason why ut's sports management department will never surpass that of rice or michigan. i woke up dreading class each day, and never has the 11-floor drop from the top of belmont seemed more appealing than after each class. i wanted to be a pt, but this class made me drop out of the kin program and become a communications major.

Class-352k. Please don't listen to the recent positive ratings with no substance. For your own good, choose literally any other KIN elective. I know the writing flag seems tempting, but this class is terrible. She is super cryptic and intimidating, puts in 0 effort, and I can confirm the other claims that she hit a student with a pen. DO NOT TAKE.

Worst class I have taken. It is EXTREMELY unorganized, does not follow the syllabus, gives major assignments with hardly any guidance, horrible communication, and tough grading. She never posted lecture slides. Not to mention she threw a dry erase marker across the room at a student for whispering with no previous warning. Awful class.

(-) Seems like a cool person ig but that's all I can say
(+) Terrible at letting us know if class was in-person or zoom. Bad at giving instructions for in-class assignments & knocked off points for instructions she never gave. Never posted slides or study guides despite exams being lecture heavy. Same as last years reviews, just overall, bad.

I love Dr. Shaw! I have taken two of her classes and am registered for a third. She cares so much about her students. She is super fun and hilarious! She gives good constructive feedback and will help you, so do not be afraid to ask her. I have loved being in her class!

Dr. Shaw is one of the best professors I have ever had! She truly cares about her students, and it shows. She brings us coffee and pastries to early morning classes, and ALWAYS checks on her students. If you participate and complete your assignments on time, you will have no problem getting a good grade in this class. She is the best!
Great person!

I have been indifferent to Dr. Shaws class this semester, but something she did today shocked me. Im not sure what the situation was, but I saw her THROW A WHITEBOARD PEN AT A STUDENT. I dont care why, thats totally out of line. I'd stay away from her classes tbh

Hard to rate, cool person, ig she can be intimidating. I never felt scared to speak, but I can see why other people could feel that way. Doesn't post slides + lectures heavy so if you don't go you wont pass. My one main complaint is that its so lecture heavy and she takes a long time to grade. If you go to class, take notes, study, you'll be fine

I feel bad giving her a poor rating, but I feel like there were a lot of things wrong with her class and teaching style. She didn't really teach us anything. She was more of a facilitator for our group projects while grading us unreasonably hard and giving little to no instruction. I feel like with time, she'll get better, but 355 was a disaster.

such a hard grader and her feedback makes 0 sense. She will take off 10+ points off of a paper for the SMALLEST thing and papers are a large percentage of your grade. assignments had absolutely no criteria or guidance. VERY political and I was afraid to speak out for the opposite position because she would've taken it out against me and my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Overall not a great professor. Gives lots of assignments with little guidance. Very hard to get a hold of if you have questions. Professor called off class at least 4 separate occasions and had the TA doing the lecture. Grades very hard.

She is really disorganized and you really don't know your grade in the class until the end of the semester. The class does not follow the syllabus. She threw us into assignments and projects with little to no guidance and she grades harshly. Not a mean lady like the other comment claims, just really disorganized.
Interesting content, but very time consuming. Spent longer working on this class each week than Physics 2.

I took this ancient Rome class for my VAPA, and it is way more work than I was expecting. There are weekly lecture videos (~2 hours), Perusall comments every week, 2 essays, and 4 challenging tests. I would take a different course for VAPA credit if you can. But Pittard is super engaging and the content (even though it's a lot) is interesting.
Took this class because I thought it was going to be an easy A, and I just found out the professor now switched to making exams 65 questions, monitored, and worth 40% of your grade. Not worth it.
Took this online. You just watch lectures, take quiz, and do annotations each week. 2 essays. Easy A if you stay on top of the work.

This class is very manageable—just stay on top of lectures and readings. You'll write two papers, but they're easy if you pay attention. Homework mostly involves simple annotations based on short readings. The content is straightforward, though lecture-heavy so ensure to watch them. Great and easy way to earn VAPA credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Pittard was a good professor, this class is super easy, it just requires you write 2 papers mid semester and a final paper that is a bit longer than the others (first 2 about 2-4 pages, final paper about 5-7). Content is easy but there are a lot of lectures, the annotations are easy as well don't put too much work into them as they are auto graded.

online and asynch. shes very passionate about this topic and she makes the class very easy. most of the grading comes from weekly quizzes and we only have 3 essays which are graded very easily. also weekly annotations but those take like 10 minutes. overall very easy class and good prof, if ur looking to take an easy vapa this is the one

very sweet prof, instapolls everyday but super easy to do, no exams just an end-of-year final paper that's like 8-10 pgs double spaced. super easy class, content is heavily based on lectures so just go to class and you'll pass lol

The majority of the class was lecture based, which took me ~2-3 hours to complete, depending on the week. There were also weekly quizzes and 3 papers (the last being the final). Was a bit of a time sink, but i really enjoyed her class and passion for the subject. It's not my degree, but I'll definitely learn more about Rome if i can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The professor is very passionate about what she teachers and she cares that her students understand the content. Grade is based on weekly quizzes, annotations, and a few essays.

She's a great lecturer and you can tell she loves what she does. I took the online course. You'll want to make sure you pay attention to readings because about half of the quizzes are based on that (the other half comes from the lecture). There is a lot of reading sometimes, but you'll be fine as long as you plan accordingly.

You know that meme about men only thinking about the Roman empire? This is a great class for that. Jokes aside, she was a great grader and lecturer and the class being online allowed for much flexibility. Grades were quizzes and essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class wasnt too bad, quizzes were just like lecture and the annotations were also easy to do if you read carefully. One 3 page eassy, 10 minute video submission and a 5-7 page final.

Dr. Pittard is SO knowledgeable on Ancient Roman history and was great at conveying this with us. She is eloquent, fun, and incredibly understanding. Weekly quizzes were annoying but fairly easy. For the papers, I recommend really getting to know your TAs and asking them for guidance as you complete them cause the rubrics felt unclear to me.

Pittard's lectures can be long and kind of boring, but if you speed them up they are fine. There are weekly quizzes but the lowest two get dropped, weekly perusal annotations, two papers, and a final project instead of an exam. It is a relatively easy VAPA and she offers weekly extra credit points too.

very easy class if you watch the video lectures and take notes, and do the weekly readings w/ annotations. the quizzes are directly from those 2 things and straightforward. 3 essays/videos for major grades, but easy if you put in the effort. Dr. Pittard is passionate and a great lecturer, made Rome interesting even though I had no initial interest.
She is very knowledgeable, not too much work just go to lectures for intro to Rome and keep up with the content. A few essays and discussion posts, not difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Pittard is my favorite professor I've ever had. I wish she could teach all of my classes as she is so passionate about her subject and inspires your want to learn more as well. A lot of the readings are interesting and all her lectures are as well, she's very good at keeping you engaged and she genuinely cares about her students.

the class is just so boring and unless you are interested in ancient things then sure you might like it. the readings were like another language so i didn't understand half of it. the quizzes include questions from the readings and lectures so you actually have to read and pay attention in class. you also must go to class for participation credit

Took for VAPA pulled off an A without reading. Instapolls for attendance but they're just participation. Lectures are pretty interesting and not super heavy. Have some discussions and essays, but they aren't too hard & theres TI sessions for help. Weekly quiz (online) due Sunday (usually 10-15 questions). Dr. Pittard is so kind and caring though!
Love her!! She gave great lectures and was so knowledgeable about the course. She really cares about her students. The course load was pretty light and the TA's graded fairly. Would take again!

Love her!! She gave great lectures and was so knowledgeable about the course. She really cares about her students. The course load was pretty light and the TA's graded pretty fairly. Would take again!

This class was alright, I didn't love professor Pittard's teaching style all that much. But in this class u have weekly quizzes s which forces u to do the readings. Also u absolutely can't skip class because instapoll is heavily weighted. Other than that its pretty easy. The big assignments are graded lightly.

Dr. Pittard was very knowledgeable on all of the topics that she taught in class. She cared a lot for her students and wanted everyone to succeed. There were a lot of readings that we were asked about through instapolls during class and on the weekly quizzes, but both were manageable and not too hard. All in all, it was a good VAPA.

reviews.comment: Professor Pittard is a very kind professor who clearly loves what she teaches. Her lectures were surprisingly interesting for an engineer taking Greek Mythology, having frequent interesting moments. There are instapolls most classes, but 15% were dropped so you had to attend 85% of the time basically. Good class for VAPA.

Professor Pittard is a really good professor. She puts energy into lectures even when they sometimes seem like a drag. The course itself was really fascinating. Learning about mythology was definitely a good choice for a VAPA. There are sometimes a lot of readings but it's never too bad.

reviews.comment: Loved Dr. Pittard's lectures. She enjoys the material and it comes through in lectures. Been a minute since I took her but glad I did. reviews.comment: Super nice! Professor Pittard is really knowledgeable and very passionate about mythology. There are weekly quizzes and readings, but as long as you to the lectures and skim the readings, you'll be fine. There are 3 essays and no final and the essays are pretty easy.

I love professor Pittard. She is a very articulate speaker and She is knowledgeable about her field of study. There are lots of weekly readings that can be tiresome. reviews.comment: Many insta-polls quizzes based on the many readings. No need to read all of it tho, just read the summaries online. They should be enough to answer the questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed just about everything we did in this course. Professor Pittard is extremely nice and caring about her students, and the graded material is in no way unfair or particularly difficult. Readings are the hardest part of the course, but if you do them and take notes alongside going to lectures you should ace the course.

reviews.comment:
Very passionate about her lectures. I was just taking the class for my VAPA credit, but it was nice!

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Pittard is an amazing professor. I took this class initially just to fill my VAPA requirement but ended up really enjoying the class. One of the best professors I've had!

Professor PIttard is such a caring professor. She clearly is very educated on what she does. It is not a very difficult class to do well in as long as you put in the effort (which isn't too much). A great VAPA choice if you need one, I recommend her!

I really only took this class for the VAPA credit, but I ended up loving it. Dr. Pittard is clearly passionate about Roman culture and she's really good at teaching it. Just keep up with the readings and take notes during lectures and you'll be fine.

I really enjoyed the lectures. It was not an easy class but it was not very hard either. It was a decent amount of readings which you had to do before every class so you could answer instapolls, but the readings do get more interesting as you learn and understand the mythology more. I definitely enjoyed learning in this course.

reviews.comment: Professor PIttard is super caring and she made introductory Greek do-able. reviews.comment: Dr. Pittard was a great professor, and was clearly very passionate about ancient Greek history. Sobnack is a sweet guy who wants his students to succeed, however the way he formats his tests is less focused on if you know the material and more so if you understand the weird way he's asking you to do it which is pretty hit or miss. it will definitely push you to understand math better however it might mess with your gpa
I think he got rejected from art school and decided to just abuse poor pre meds instead of going after a different community

This class WILL make you smarter & I appreciate in retrospect.
Difficult quizzes and exams beyond what other M408D classes have, 1-2 quizzes drops, homework is effective and not too extensive, practice/textbook questions help with preparing, very high curves.

This is the WORST professor at UT Austin. Genuinely do not know where he dropped in from, but he is not prepared to teach a class, nor is he someone who should be giving students grades. the curve is rlly good but he's a terrible teacher but a chill, quirky guy that just wants to wall climb. hardest tests ever and hw easy.

reviews.comment: He cares very deeply about film and teaches it well. He also is slightly eviI. He has high expectations and tweaks if there's low engagement  He treats this as a weed-out class, forgetting that he actually teaches an INTRO class.

Arturo is an okay professor! Professor Jimenez is my favorite professor I've had so far! His lectures were so informative and helpful to get an intro understanding of the industry.

Prof. Jimenez is extremely passionate about the film industry, sometimes to a fault. The 3 film projects are tough to organize but are graded fairly, and the TA's give lots of incredible feedback on your work.

Very knowledgeable professor but expected students to have some sort of background in GIS. Labs were not too difficult and course content was interesting. Didn't rely too much on the textbooks and exams were not too difficult.

Dr. Arima's lectures were very interesting although a coupleof the concepts are difficult to understand at first. He is very understanding and cares about his students, and he has a very funny sense of humor. The labs weren't too difficult but make sure to put time into the outside assignments and start studying for exams a couple days beforehand.

The textbook is amazing, you should do the readings (yes you don't need to to pass, but it's really interesting!)

Dr. Arredondo is the most kind and caring professor I have had throughout my time at UT. You can tell she truly cares about her students and has compassion for them as human beings! Dr. Arredondo is incredibly kind and her lectures and tests are extremely easy and somewhat common sense. Her powerpoints are super easy to understand and help a lot with the tests. The grading distribution is very fair and you will without a doubt get an A, highly recommend her class!!

I didn't pay attention in class also 6 free absences and I studied the day or two before the exams and I did well on the exams. Memorization based exams mostly. Just take her!

reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

Exams are fair, and she offers a bit of extra credit.

I would definitely take intro to Italian with Arianna again if given the chance, she is such a kind professor and understanding! this course felt like so much work. Always hard to find big project assignment instructions on canvas. disorganized. Very harsh grader. Curriculum is very interesting! Good lecturer, not much class interaction.
